title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience leading technical initiatives or engineering teams

  • Strong C#/.NET expertise

  • Experience designing distributed systems and/or microservices

  • Good SQL/NoSQL fundamentals

  • Experience with APIs, domain modelling and event-driven architectures

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and modern software delivery

  • Experience with cloud technologies, containers and orchestration

  • An engineering mindset around reliability, observability, security and performance

  • The ability to mentor developers and communicate technical decisions clearly

The current environment includes C#/.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework, MS SQL Server, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and Visual Studio, with Azure, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code increasingly relevant.

Why Cubris?

Because you will have unusually visible technical influence.

You will not simply inherit somebody else's engineering system. You will help define how Cubris builds software: the architecture, engineering practices, quality standards and technical guardrails that enable the organisation to scale.

And the software has a tangible purpose: helping make modern railway operations smarter, more predictable and more energy-efficient.

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Department: Software Production
Reports to: Development Manager

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description:
Job titleSenior Sourcing SpecialistJob description:

At BeGreen, we develop and operate renewable energy projects built to last across generations.

We are looking for a commercially driven Senior Sourcing Specialist with a strong background in renewables to lead sourcing activities and commercial contracting across solar, hybrid, and energy storage projects based in Denmark, with exposure to international suppliers and projects.

This position is ideal for someone who understands the unique sourcing and commercial challenges of renewable energy, whether in solar, BESS, or hybrid technologies—and who knows that the right supplier relationships and contracts are what make or break a project. Broader experience in energy infrastructure, construction, or adjacent industries is equally welcome, and will add valuable perspective to our team.

About the role

You will take ownership of sourcing strategies, supplier engagement, and contract execution across the full renewable energy project lifecycle. Working closely with Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Sustainability, Cyber Security, HSE, and Legal, you will ensure that commercial decisions drive project performance and long-term value.

Your hands-on knowledge of the renewables market—its key suppliers, technology trends, cost drivers, and contractual complexities—will be a distinct advantage in this role. Whether you're navigating a large EPC tender for a solar park, structuring a BESS supply agreement, or evaluating a new contractor in an emerging market, your sector insight will be central to how you work.

Beyond large and complex tenders, you will also support pragmatic sourcing for lower-value purchases, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and speed without compromising quality or governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end competitive tenders for major renewable energy packages, including planning, evaluation, negotiation, and contract award
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies specifically tailored to solar parks, hybrid plants, and battery energy storage systems
  • Leverage renewables market knowledge to drive supplier assessments, benchmark pricing, and identify strategic sourcing opportunities
  • Lead commercial negotiations with energy suppliers and contractors, with a strong focus on risk management and contract robustness
  • Manage both complex, high-value sourcing processes and agile lower-value purchasing activities (RFQs, call-offs, POs)
  • Prepare decision-making materials, including total cost of ownership analyses with a clear understanding of energy project cost structures
  • Support early contract management, including supplier onboarding, performance tracking, and risk assessments
  • Contribute market intelligence on renewable energy supply chains to strengthen category strategies and long-term supplier partnerships

What you bring

We are looking for someone with a solid commercial background, and we particularly value:

  • Direct sourcing or commercial experience in solar, BESS, hybrid energy, wind or other renewable technologies
  • Familiarity with key renewable energy suppliers, EPC contractors, and technology providers
  • Understanding of the commercial and technical dynamics specific to utility-scale renewable projects

Broader energy & infrastructure experience (also highly valued):

  • Experience in conventional energy, oil & gas, transmission, or large-scale infrastructure procurement
  • Background in complex project environments with multi-stakeholder commercial interfaces
  • Exposure to long-term contracts, framework agreements, and supplier performance management

In addition, you bring:

  • Confidence in leading negotiations and managing commercial interfaces
  • A structured, proactive, and ownership-driven approach to work
  • Strong stakeholder management and clear communication skills
  • Knowledge of EU procurement regulations (Utilities Directive) or the motivation to build it
  • Fluency in English; proficiency in Danish or Swedish is a plus
  • Relocation packages are not available for this role and a valid Danish work- and residence permit is a precondition

The team you will join

You will join BeGreen's Procurement team, a group of specialists working across category management, sourcing, and contract management. We collaborate closely, share knowledge openly, and prioritize integrity in both processes and relationships.

What we offer

  • A key role in shaping sourcing practices at a fast-growing renewable energy company
  • Influence across the full project lifecycle—from early development through construction to operations
  • A collaborative, international work environment with passionate and ambitious colleagues
  • A strong focus on professional development and continuous learning
  • Office based in Carlsberg Byen, Copenhagen.


About BeGreen

BeGreen develops, builds, and operates onshore energy facilities – primarily solar, wind, and battery solutions. We are around 60 colleagues from diverse backgrounds. We design our projects to work in practice – technically, commercially, and in interaction with local communities.

BeGreen is headquartered in Denmark and is part of Equinor, an international energy company. This provides a strong foundation and access to experience and competencies across markets.

Our values: collaboration, integrity and ambition are applied to our projects, decisions, and the way we work together internally and externally.

title: Operating Partner & General Manager (Profit Sharing & Equity)
description:
Operating Partner & General Manager – RAY'S Chicken

We run RAY'S Chicken at Hejrevej in Nordvest, sharing a roof and a taproom with Gamma Brewing. We take a lot of pride in what we do: 24-hour buttermilk marinades, custom spice rubs, homemade sauces, and fried chicken that stands out in Copenhagen.

We are ready to build RAY'S into a multi-location brand. To do that, we need a partner on the ground to take over the daily operation of our flagship location, dial in our systems, and build the foundation for our next openings.

This role comes with base pay, direct profit sharing, and an equity track.

What the Job Looks Like

You will start on the floor. To run and expand this business, you need to understand every moving part firsthand.

  • Step 1: Learn the Shop You'll spend your first weeks working the line—prepping chicken, running the fryers, packing orders, handling Wolt and takeaway rushes, and talking to guests.

  • Step 2: Take Full Ownership of Hejrevej Once you know the rhythm of the place, you take the reins of day-to-day operations: scheduling the crew, ordering from suppliers, keeping food costs tight, staying on top of Fødevarestyrelsen hygiene standards, and making sure the food quality never slips.

  • Step 3: Build for Expansion You'll help turn our daily workflows into clear, repeatable routines so that training new staff is easy. When we are ready to open location number two, you will be deeply involved in site setup, hiring, and launch.

Who We Are Looking For

You do not need years of high-end restaurant experience. If you have run a busy kitchen or managed a bar, great. But if your background is in retail, small business, logistics, or running physical projects and you love fast-paced, hands-on work, we want to hear from you.

Here is what actually matters to us:

  • High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs fixing. If a station is dirty, an order is delayed, or inventory is running low, you jump in and solve it.

  • Comfortable on Your Feet:  You enjoy the energy of a packed Friday night shift and you lead your team by working alongside them.

  • Organized & Practical: You notice small details. You can build simple checklists, manage inventory without wasting stock, and keep a kitchen running cleanly under pressure.

  • Good with People: You stay calm and constructive when the ticket machine is going non-stop and the room is full. You treat your team with respect and set a solid pace.

  • Long-Term Mindset: You want to build something real and share in the financial upside through profit distribution and equity as the business grows.

The Deal

  • Compensation: Base salary after experience with a road map to profit sharing.

  • Equity Pathway: Clear, milestone-based equity vesting as you take full operational ownership and we expand.

  • Direct Access: You work directly alongside the founders. No bureaucracy, no corporate politics—good ideas get tested and put into action immediately.

  • Great Location: A vibrant base at Hejrevej 6B in Nordvest, working alongside the Gamma Brewing team.

How to Apply

Send us your CV along with a short email telling us:

  1. What you have built, managed, or fixed in previous jobs.

  2. Why running and scaling a food business at this stage makes sense for you.

  • Email: work@diamondslice.dk

  • Subject: Rays Partner

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling

Vi forestiller os, at du:

title: Deltids regnskabsassistent til Nordens førende restaurantsite
description:
Er du struktureret og har en god forståelse for bogholderi? Nyder du at kunne gå på weekend og vide, at tallene stemmer? Så er du måske vores nye regnskabsassistent. 

DinnerBooking er en danskejet IT-baseret virksomhed, som leverer et markedsførende online bookingsystem til restauranter på tværes af Norden og flere lande i Europa.  

DinnerBooking fornemmeste opgave er at give gæster inspiration og nem adgang til restauranter gennem vores digitale platform, samtidig med at vi leverer det mest værdiskabende bookingsystem til restauratører.  

Din rolle 

Vi søger en kollega til vores bogholderi, som vil få berøring med en bred pallette af bogføringsopgaver og mulighed for at få masser af ansvar. Derfor er det også en styrke, at du kender dine begrænsninger og siger til, hvis du løber ind i en udfordring, du ikke selv kan løse. Her prioriterer vi at løfte som et team og hjælpe hinanden, så vi får løbet opgaverne i mål. 

Dine opgaver 

  • Debitorbogholderi og håndtering, herunder rykkerprocedurer, sikre opfølgning på kundebetaling og korrespondance vedrørende mellemværende 

  • Finansbogføring 

  • Fakturering og håndtering af ordrer 

  • Håndtering af moms samt varetage dialog til offentlige myndigheder 

  • Afstemning af diverse konti 

  • Lønkørsel (kun danske lønninger via Danløn) 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har nogle års erfaring med forskellige opgaver inden for bogholderi  

  • Du mestre dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale 

  • Er struktureret i din måde at løse opgaver på samt formår at overholde deadlines 

  • Navigerer hjemmevant i Excel 

  • Er nysgerrig og altid interesseret i at forbedre processer og kvalitet 

Hvordan du har opnået din erfaring, er ikke centralt for stillingen, men vi forventer, at du har en god grundforståelse for tal og bogholderi.  

 
Vi tilbyder  

En spændende rolle i en voksende virksomhed, hvor du får masser af ansvar og frihed. Du bliver desuden del af et kontor, som i dag består 35 dedikerede medarbejdere fra både Danmark, Estland, England, Ukraine, Polen, Norge, Finland og Rumænien.  

Vi er et socialt kontor med en uformel tone, og hvor to dage sjældent er ens. Vi nyder at tage en dialog omkring kaffemaskinen, og to gange om året spiser vi sammen til restaurantfestivalen DinnerDays, som vi selv arrangerer. 

Vi tilbyder en god frokostordning og et kontor placeret tæt ved Amagerbro Metro. 

Arbejdstid: 12-16 timer med mulighed for fleksibilitet. 

Løn: Løn forhandles efter kvalifikationer. 

Deadline 
Send os dit CV og ansøgning i én samlet PDF allerede i dag til job@dinnerbooking.com. Vi kigger på ansøgningerne løbende. 
 
Nysgerrig? 

Hvis du ønsker at høre mere ind til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Peter Thygesen på pt@dinnerbooking.com.

title: Stefanshjemmet søger ledsager til beboer.
description:
Ansøgning om ledsager og/eller frivillig.


Hvem er jeg:

Jeg er en ung kvinde på 50 år. Jeg har en skøn forlovede og to dejlige børn, som jeg alle ønsker at bruge så meget tid med som muligt. Jeg er halvsiddet lammet. Jeg sidder derfor i en el-kørestol til dagligt. Jeg har lært mig selv at køre rundt indenfor trygge rammer, og nyder den frihed det giver mig. Jeg er ikke så god til nye mennesker, men jeg er stadigvæk klar på at lære dig at kende og få nogle gode oplevelser sammen! Udover dette er jeg meget humoristisk i min tilgang til mennesker. Jeg er rap i replikken og altid klar med en god bemærkning.

 Jeg har ikke behov for at snakke hele tiden. Jeg kan godt lide, at de aktiviteter jeg er i gang med ikke har en masse mennesker involveret, da jeg gerne vil koncentrere mig om det jeg laver.
Jeg kan godt lide at bruge min fritid på at læse, tegne, træne, ordne mit blomsterbed, køre ture i haven, være sammen med familien og min forlovede.

 
Hvad har jeg brug for dig til:

Jeg vil gerne have hjælp med at cykle i weekenderne, når jeg skal besøge familie og når jeg skal op og handle ind. Ift cykling, så vil jeg helst gerne kl. 11:00. Men er dette ikke muligt for dig, så kan vi også godt aftale et andet tidspunkt. Det der betyder mest for mig, det er at finde en ledsager, som kan hjælpe mig med at cykle i weekenderne, da dette er noget jeg vægter meget højt i min dagligdag.


Hvem er du:

Jeg søger en ledsager/frivillig som er tålmodig af natur, at du kan tilpasse dig mine faste aftaler jeg har i min dagligdag. Jeg ser gerne, at du har en god portion humor/ironi, så vi indimellem kan få nogle gode grin sammen. Du skal være nysgerrig på at lære mig at kende som menneske, på trods af mine få udfordringer. Du ser gerne, at du er stabil og ansvarsbevidst. Det vil give mig tryghed i at vide, at du har erfaring indenfor handicapområdet/arbejdet med mennesker tidligere.


Hvis du synes det her lyder som for dig, så vil jeg gerne at du tager kontakt til min kontaktperson Casper. Han kan kontaktes på afdelingens telefon nr.: +45 4186 6727 eller på mail: pvca@aarhus.dk.

Jeg glæder mig til at høre fra dig!

 ansøgning og CV skal sendes til stefanshjemmet@aarhus.dk

Du kan også få mere at vide om Stefanshjemmet på vores hjemmeside: www.stefanshjemmet.dk.

Du vil blive ansat af Stefanshjemmet og Løn og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomster.

title: Postdoc Position in Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute, The University of Southern Denmark in Sønderborg, Denmark
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a postdoctoral research associate in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and (Photo)electrochemistry, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, a part of MCI, and it is integrated into the novel, active working group CatMatX, a research laboratory focused on developing next-generation catalytic materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications,  by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing project proposals to support research at SDU NanoSYD. 

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, and evaluation of materials performance in solar water splitting;

  • Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.;

  • Publishing of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals with high impact factors.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics; 

  • Assistance in teaching activities; 

  • Assistance in setting up the research infrastructure;

  • Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding. 

Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, Electrochemistry, or related fields; 

  • Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds;

  • Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM);   

  • Proven track record of publishing in international peer-reviewed scientific journals as leading author;

  • Fluency in English (both spoken and written);

  • Ability to work in teams and also independently; 

  • Strong communication skills; 

  • Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry. 

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities, DFT calculations and MD simulations;

  • Research experience in electrochemistry and solar water splitting; 

  • Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project; 

  • Proven record in participating in national and international research projects;

  • Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group.

Contact information

For more information about the department and the position, please contact Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk) and Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and it starts on 01.03.2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

To qualify for the position as postdoc you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s previous research work and experience most relevant to the offered position.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Certificates/Diplomas (Bachelor, Master, and PhD degrees) – Danish and/or English transcripts. 

  • Complete list of publications (please highlight publications most relevant to the offered position).

  • Research statement on developing novel transition metal-based mixed anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting.

  • A reference letter may be submitted, but is not required. 

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is October 31, 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST).

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper søges til fast aftenvagt på Løsning Friplejehjem
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe gode aftener for vores beboere – med nærvær, omsorg, faglighed og tid til det, der betyder noget? Og har du lyst til at være en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi arbejder ud fra tydelige værdier og hjælper hinanden på tværs?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger til fast aftenvagt på Løsning Friplejehjem.

Løsning Friplejehjem åbnede den 1. juni 2026 og har plads til 30 beboere. Vi er godt i gang med at skabe det hjem og den arbejdsplads, vi drømte om – og nu søger vi en engageret og omsorgsfuld social- og sundhedshjælper, som har lyst til at blive en del af holdet.

Hos os ønsker vi først og fremmest at skabe et HJEM. Et varmt, rummeligt og trygt sted, hvor beboerne mødes med respekt, nærvær og høj faglighed – og hvor deres ønsker, vaner og selvbestemmelse har betydning for, hvordan vi tilrettelægger hverdagen.

Som aftenvagt får du en vigtig rolle i netop dette. Aftenen skal ikke blot være en række opgaver, der skal nås. Der skal være plads til det gode måltid, samtalen, hyggen, den nødvendige pleje og en tryg afslutning på dagen – med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers ønsker og behov.

Vores værdigrundlag

Løsning Friplejehjem bygger på et kristent menneskesyn, hvor troen udgør fundamentet for vores værdier og tilgang til omsorg, pleje og fællesskab. Værdigrundlaget er en naturlig del af hverdagen og præger både relationen til beboerne, samarbejdet med pårørende og samspillet mellem medarbejdere.

Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde loyalt ud fra dette værdigrundlag og har forståelse for, at det er en integreret del af livet på plejehjemmet. Læs mere her.  

 

Om stillingen

Som social- og sundhedshjælper bliver du en vigtig del af beboernes hverdag og livskvalitet.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • personlig pleje og praktisk hjælp med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboers ønsker, behov og ressourcer

  • observation af ændringer i beboernes fysiske og psykiske tilstand

title: Industrial Painter
description:
Industrial Painter Wanted for Give Steel A/S

Do you have experience with surface treatment of steel structures? Are you skilled in spray painting and using airless pump equipment? And do you thrive in a busy work environment where quality and safety are top priorities?

If so, Give Steel A/S is looking for an Industrial Painter to join our painting department in Brande.

You will become part of an international company specialising in the surface treatment of large steel structures. Our painting department operates 24/7 throughout the week, while your position will primarily be on the day shift.

Why Choose Us?

We continuously develop and improve our production processes and utilise modern equipment for surface treatment and fire protection coatings. You will have access to state-of-the-art facilities, including newly built paint halls with advanced ventilation systems and a new water-based paint application facility.

We prioritise a safe and positive working environment and value teamwork, mutual respect, and strong social relationships.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will be responsible for spray painting steel structures using primarily airless pump equipment. We focus on using modern technology and equipment to support efficient production processes.

Safety is a key aspect of surface treatment work. You will therefore receive thorough training in safety procedures as well as the handling of waste materials and residues generated during the painting process.

Your Primary Responsibilities

You will work with:

  • Surface treatment of large steel structures.
  • Spray painting using primarily airless pump equipment.
  • Following established safety procedures.
  • Handling waste materials and residues from the surface treatment process.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a reliable and team-oriented employee with experience in the surface treatment of steel structures.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a valid epoxy certificate.
  • Have experience with surface treatment of steel structures.
  • Have experience using airless pump equipment.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Work well as part of a team.
  • Speak and write either Danish or English.

What We Offer

  • Skilled and supportive colleagues.
  • A positive work environment with a strong focus on safety and well-being.
  • A workplace built on strong social values.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Canteen scheme and additional employee benefits.
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
  • Fitness facilities and massage services.

Practical Information

  • Working hours: Full-time position on the day shift.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • Location: Give Steel A/S, Sjællandsvej 14, 7330 Brande, Denmark.

Would You Like to Join the Team?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact the Painting Department Team Leader, Kenneth Helmuth Thomassen,  +45 66 50 77 44

Please submit your CV and clearly state your relevant experience.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and the job posting will be removed once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company specialising in the design, engineering, production, and installation of load-bearing steel structures and steel roof trusses.

Quality, safety, and documentation are integral parts of our daily work. We also focus on climate considerations, material selection, and documentation throughout both the engineering and production processes.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and excellent opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our everyday work.

title: Køkkenmedhjælper søges til Løsning Friplejehjem
description:
Har du lyst til at være en del af et køkken, hvor god mad, hjemlighed og fællesskab er i centrum? Har du energi, gåpåmod og hænderne godt skruet på – og trives du med en hverdag, hvor både madlavning, opvask og rengøring er en naturlig del af arbejdet?

Så er det måske dig, vi søger som køkkenmedhjælper på Løsning Friplejehjem.

Løsning Friplejehjem åbnede den 1. juni 2026 og har plads til 30 beboere. Som køkkenmedhjælper bliver du en vigtig del af hverdagen i vores køkken og kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores køkkenleder.

Du behøver ikke at være uddannet inden for køkkenfaget. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til køkkenarbejdet, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og bidrager med energi og godt humør.

Vores køkken skal ikke blot producere mad – det skal være en levende del af hjemmet. Her må duften af dagens middag gerne brede sig i huset. En frivillig kan komme forbi og skrælle kartofler, en medarbejder kan give en hånd med, og vores beboere skal kunne kigge forbi, følge med og deltage i det, der giver mening for den enkelte.

Dine opgaver

Din hverdag vil blandt andet bestå af at:

  • hjælpe til med den daglige madlavning og klargøring i køkkenet

  • smøre brød og klargøre mad til aftensmåltidet

  • bage kage og andre lækkerier

  • hjælpe med tilberedning af fx varme retter og desserter, hvis du har lyst og mod på det

  • varetage opvask og rengøring i og omkring køkkenet

  • være med til at sikre orden og god hygiejne

  • samarbejde med køkkenlederen og øvrige medarbejdere på plejehjemmet

  • bidrage til en god, respektfuld og positiv kultur i huset.

Uddannelse er ikke et krav. Du kan fx have sabbatår, være i gang med en anden uddannelse med mulighed for at arbejde i dagtimerne eller ganske enkelt være én, der holder af køkkenarbejde og gerne vil have et meningsfuldt arbejde.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • har energi, gåpåmod og lyst til at tage fat

  • kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre

  • er struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt

  • ser, hvad der skal gøres, og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • er fleksibel og løsningsorienteret

  • møder beboere, kolleger og andre i huset med respekt og nærvær

  • bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø

  • har let til smil og grin – også når der er fart på.

Vores værdigrundlag

Løsning Friplejehjem bygger på et kristent menneskesyn, hvor troen udgør fundamentet for vores værdier og tilgang til omsorg, pleje og fællesskab. Værdigrundlaget er en naturlig del af hverdagen og præger både relationen til beboerne, samarbejdet med pårørende og samspillet mellem medarbejdere.

Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde loyalt ud fra dette værdigrundlag og har forståelse for, at det er en integreret del af livet på plejehjemmet. Læs mere på vores hjemmeside her.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Stillingen er på 30 timer pr. uge, fordelt på alle hverdage kl. 8-14.

·        Der kan i forbindelse med helligdage, ferie og særlige arrangementer være behov for en vis fleksibilitet. Dette aftales naturligvis i dialog.

title: Er du vores nye kollega i dagtid
description:
Vi er et bosted Holstedgaard, beliggende i Næstved og rummer 69 beboere med forskellige diagnoser inden for det psykiatriske område. I tillæg til dette har mange af vores beboere også kompliceret somatiske lidelser. Alle vores beboere har det til fælles, at de ikke er udadreagerende.

Vores beboere er fordelt på flere teams. Det er i et af disse teams, du vil skulle arbejde sammen med en personalegruppe, af tværfaglige stærke mennesker. Dine fremtidige kollegaer kan og vil rigtig meget og vi værdsætter og værner om, at vores teams skal arbejde på at være selvkørende

Dine vigtigste opgaver hos os vil være: 

  • Grundlæggende sygepleje hos beboerne

  • Medicin administration og injektioner

  • Sundhedsfaglig og socialpædagogisk dokumentation

  • Indgå i tværfagligt teamsamarbejde og arbejde med afsæt i Holstedgaards socialpædagogiske metoder

Dine kompetencer: 

  • Uddannet og autoriseret social og sundhedsassistent.

  • Drives af at arbejde med mennesker, med forskellige behov og udfordringer.

  • Har overblik og kan handle selvstændigt 

  • Har lysten til at udvikle dig og ser fælles succes som målet

  • Ønsker at modtage elever og evt. ønsker at tage en efteruddannelse som vejleder, hvis du ikke allerede har det. 

  • Du må gerne have arbejdet med, eller have kendskab til principperne i Low Arousal, Recovery og KRAP-modellen, men det er ikke et krav, da du vil få kendskab til dem hos os.

Det får du hos os:

  • En skøn samling af beboere, som altid byder på gode udfordringer og godt samvær. 

  • En personalekultur præget af en uformel omgangstone, faglig og personlig udvikling, nysgerrighed, fleksibilitet, åbenhed, klar kommunikation, engagement, samt humor og glæde

  • Regelmæssig ekstern supervision

  • Intern opkvalificering, gennem intern og ekstern undervisning

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

  • Adgang til motionsrum

  • Pædagogiske måltider, så maden er inkluderet som en del af arbejdet

  • Personale arrangementer og rigtige julegaver, ingen honninghjerter hos os!!  

Som udgangspunkt er stillingen med arbejdstider i dagstid, hver 2. weekender og helligdage. Vi har en forventning om at du arbejder hos os mellem 25 og 37 timer. Alt dette drøftes nærmer ved en evt. samtale.

Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af loven om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. Ansættelsen kan først påbegyndes, når attesten er indhentet

Kørekort: ikke et must, men en fordel.

Er denne stilling noget for dig, vil vi glæde os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende. Bemærk: Vi sender ikke bekræftelse for modtagne ansøgninger.

Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden annoncens udløb, er stillingen besat til en anden ansøger.

Dine oplysninger bliver gemt i 60 dage, hvorefter de destrueres.

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

title: Sygeplejerske søges til Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem
description:
Sygeplejerske søges til Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem

30–32 timer om ugen · Opstart 1. november 2026 · Ingen weekendarbejde

Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for vores beboere og samtidig være med til at styrke den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig.

På Holstebro-Alstrup Friplejehjem søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk sygeplejerske til 30–32 timer om ugen med opstart 1. november 2026.

Stillingen er en opnormering af vores sygeplejefaglige indsats, og du bliver vores anden sygeplejerske. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores nuværende sygeplejerske, ledelsen og det øvrige personale.

En hverdag tæt på beboerne

Hos os er sygeplejersken en aktiv del af hverdagen. Vi tror på, at den bedste sygepleje opstår, når faglighed og nærvær går hånd i hånd. Derfor skal du have lyst til både at varetage sygeplejefaglige opgaver og tage del i den daglige pleje.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sygepleje, kliniske vurderinger og opfølgning på beboernes helbredstilstand

  • Observation, tidlig opsporing og forebyggelse

  • Medicinhåndtering og opfølgning

  • Dokumentation og kvalitetssikring

  • Koordinering med læger, hospital og øvrige samarbejdspartnere

  • Vejledning og faglig sparring med social- og sundhedsfagligt personale

  • Medvirken til at udvikle og fastholde vores faglige standarder

Den nye Ældrelov sætter fokus på selvbestemmelse, livsglæde, helhedspleje og tillid til fagligheden. Hos os skal du være med til at omsætte værdierne til praksis ved at se hele mennesket, tage udgangspunkt i beboerens ønsker og ressourcer og arbejde forebyggende og rehabiliterende.

Vi ser Ældreloven som en mulighed for at styrke det, vi allerede tror på: faglighed, nærvær og det gode hverdagsliv.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • 30–32 timer om ugen og ingen weekendarbejde

  • Opstart 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale

  • En ny opnormeret sygeplejerskefunktion med mulighed for at sætte dit præg

  • Tæt fagligt samarbejde med vores nuværende sygeplejerske

  • Mulighed for indflydelse på arbejdsgange og faglig udvikling

  • En hverdag med tæt kontakt til beboere, pårørende, frivillige og kolleger

  • Et godt tværfagligt samarbejde og mulighed for faglig udvikling

Vi søger dig, der

  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske og har lyst til at arbejde med ældre mennesker

  • Har et godt klinisk blik og kan bevare overblikket

  • Trives med både selvstændigt ansvar og teamsamarbejde

  • Er engageret, omsorgsfuld og fagligt nysgerrig

  • Har lyst til at være en aktiv del af plejen

  • Arbejder helhedsorienteret med udgangspunkt i den enkelte beboer

  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og en positiv kultur

  • Kan se mulighederne i den nye Ældrelov og omsætte den til praksis

Har du lyst til at være en del af teamet så send en ansøgning, vi tager ind til samtale løbende.

Tiltrædelse: 1. november 2026 eller efter aftale.

title: Lagermedarbejder - Videbæk

description:
Danmark Protein i Nr. Vium og HI Park i Herning søger en kvalitetsbevidst lagermedarbejder. Vi er 730 medarbejdere i en topmoderne og højteknologisk virksomhed, der producerer valle proteinpulver og mælkesukker til en bred vifte af levnedsmidler. Vi er en del af Arla Foods Ingrediens, der er en uafhængig virksomhed i Arla Foods med ambitioner om at blive verdens førende leverandør af vallebaserede ingredienser til fødevareindustrien.

Har du styr på logistik og lager? Så bliv en del af Danmark Protein, hvor sikkerhed, medarbejdertrivsel og kvalitet ligger øverst på prioriteringslisten. Her får du mulighed for at bruge din faglighed inden for logistik og lager i et uformelt og stemningsfyldt arbejdsmiljø. 
 

Du bliver en del af et team på 39 kolleger, heraf 12 i HI Park i Herning. Vi møder hinanden med respekt og åbenhed, hvor alle bidrager til en hjælpsom tone og god stemning.

 

  • Det er dig, der har det store overblik

  • Du arbejder i SAP og finder pallerne til ordrerne – alt er lokationsstyret.

  • Du finder løsninger og er proaktiv når nye udfordringer opstår.

  • Du har en indstilling til at hjælpe og sikre godt arbejdsklima.

  • Du arbejder med fokus på sikkerhed og er kvalitetsbevidst.

Som person er du hjælpsom og glad for at give en hånd med, hvor der er behov for det. Du går til arbejdet med seriøsitet og påtager dig gerne ansvar for opgaverne i afdelingen.

  • Du har truckcertifikat og taler dansk.

  • Det er et krav du kan håndtere IT, da alt sker igennem SAP.

  • Lager erfaring er ikke et krav, vi ser på hele mennesket.

  • Skriv gerne om frivilligt arbejde, træner, leder eller bestyrelsesarbejde.

  • Det vil være muligt at søge som sabbat arbejde inden uddannelse.

 

Der er 2 stillinger:

Danmark  Protein: Du vil indgå i AGV teamet, hvor vi kører i rul med skiftende arbejdstider dag/nat over 5 uger. Dag vagter fra 05:30 til 18:15 og nat vagter fra 17:30 til 06:15.

Hi Park Herning: Du vil indgå i et team på 12 medarbejdere og arbejde mellem 06:30 til 15:00.

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Postdoc Position in Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute, The University of Southern Denmark in Sønderborg, Denmark
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a postdoctoral research associate in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and (Photo)electrochemistry, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, a part of MCI, and it is integrated into the novel, active working group CatMatX, a research laboratory focused on developing next-generation catalytic materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications,  by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing project proposals to support research at SDU NanoSYD. 

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, and evaluation of materials performance in solar water splitting;

  • Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.;

  • Publishing of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals with high impact factors.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics; 

  • Assistance in teaching activities; 

  • Assistance in setting up the research infrastructure;

  • Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding. 

Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, Electrochemistry, or related fields; 

  • Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds;

  • Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM);   

  • Proven track record of publishing in international peer-reviewed scientific journals as leading author;

  • Fluency in English (both spoken and written);

  • Ability to work in teams and also independently; 

  • Strong communication skills; 

  • Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry. 

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities, DFT calculations and MD simulations;

  • Research experience in electrochemistry and solar water splitting; 

  • Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project; 

  • Proven record in participating in national and international research projects;

  • Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group.

Contact information

For more information about the department and the position, please contact Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk) and Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and it starts on 01.03.2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material.

Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

To qualify for the position as postdoc you must have obtained a PhD degree by the employment date. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • One-page motivation letter that describes the applicant’s previous research work and experience most relevant to the offered position.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Certificates/Diplomas (Bachelor, Master, and PhD degrees) – Danish and/or English transcripts. 

  • Complete list of publications (please highlight publications most relevant to the offered position).

  • Research statement on developing novel transition metal-based mixed anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, for solar water splitting.

  • A reference letter may be submitted, but is not required. 

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

The application deadline is October 31, 2026 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST).

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

Apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

title: Process Engineer - Cold Forming
description:
Are you passionate about automotive? Would you like to support and optimise running production? Do you want to work for high-end customers like BMW, Audi, Mercedes, Rolls Royce, etc. and with a very complex unique technology? If yes, our position of Process Engineer-Cold Forming can be perfectly fitting to you!

 

Your area of responsibility

You will be part of Engineering team, which supports both running production and new projects. You will have contact with Production, Quality and Maintenance colleagues.

Further responsibilities will be:

  • Supports the successful implementation of new projects, engineering and process changes, in agreement with customer, to ensure and improve quality and delivery of products, at lowest / best cost

  • Leads respective projects including cost and milestone control

  • Plans the set-up and tear-down of production equipment

  • Creates performance descriptions for equipment

  • Obtains offers for equipment and parts to purchase

  • Collects and analyzes process data by coordinating efforts of production and quality for effective problem solving and process optimization

  • Provides floor support to troubleshoot process problems using continuous improvement and root cause analysis techniques

  • Develops, revises and documents manufacturing processes to meet cost, quality, scrap, labor and safety goals

  • Implements customer product reviews by providing prototypes, tooling and equipment

  • Enforces and follows safety procedures,

  • Ensures proper balance between improvement actions, costs and environmental issues

 

Your profile

We see you with minimum bachelor’s degree in Process Engineering technology or Material Engineering or with similar major

You have more than 3 years of relevant professional experience in manufacturing companies on cold forming or relevant

You have good knowledge of Automotive Parts and Aluminum Alloys

You have an advanced English level, spoken and written, German will be considered as advantage                      

On the personal side you are a strong, proactive and loyal team player, ready to learn new things.
