title: Senior Immersion Engineer
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a naval architect, maritime engineer or offshore engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbor (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As an Immersion Engineer, you will participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In the first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In the second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, assisting the Immersion Master by giving technical advice.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

  • During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

  • You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

  • You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands

  • You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

  • You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

  • You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

  • During float up and ballasting you check if the operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

  • During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations.

  • You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

  • After immersion, you will do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

  • You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

  • You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

  • You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

  • You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

  • You are a team player with strong communication skills

  • You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

  • You are fluent in English.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

Workplace:

Based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

title: ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB
description:
ROSKILDE: THATCHERS WANTED – A BAD HAIR DAY IS ACTUALLY PART OF THE JOB

Straw in your hair.

Straw on your clothes.

Straw in places you didn’t even know straw could get into.

But at the end of the day, you’ll have a thatched roof you can look at and be proud of.

We are looking for several skilled thatchers to work on thatched roofs in and around Roskilde.

A CRAFT YOU CAN ACTUALLY SEE

Your working day will revolve around thatching and thatched roofs.

You’ll work on a variety of tasks within the trade, where craftsmanship, precision and attention to the finished result really matter.

Because there’s one slightly unforgiving thing about a thatched roof:

You have relevant training or qualifications

or

You have hands-on experience with thatching.

The important thing is that you know the trade and are able to contribute from day one.

✔ You can work independently
✔ You take pride and responsibility in your craftsmanship
✔ You have an eye for quality and a good finish

A COMPANY VEHICLE CAN BE PROVIDED

And no...

You don’t have to enjoy finding straw in your socks. That part just comes with the job.

title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

title: Tenure-track Assistant Professorship at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre with a Focus on Digital Humanities, Textual Genesis and Nineteenth-Century Literature
description:
A five-year tenure-track assistant professorship is available at the Hans Christian Andersen Centre, Department for the Study of Culture and Language, University of Southern Denmark, with appointment from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The Hans Christian Andersen Centre is an internationally leading research environment within Andersen studies. Its research encompasses literary, cultural and public dissemination-oriented approaches to Andersen’s works, life and cultural significance. The Centre conducts research at the highest international level with the aim of developing new literary, cultural and dissemination-oriented perspectives on Andersen’s complete artistic oeuvre. The Centre provides a framework for collaboration with Danish and international researchers, cultural mediators and other actors in the field.

Job Content
The assistant professorship is a tenure-track position with a view to obtaining a permanent appointment as associate professor following a positive academic assessment.

The position is affiliated with the project Hans Christian Andersen’s Fairy Tales and Stories – the Digital Manuscript Edition and will, in close interaction with the project’s existing research activities, contribute to integrating digital, philological and literary approaches.

The assistant professor will be part of the Centre’s research environment and collaborate with the project’s editorial group, with responsibility for developing research at the intersection of digital humanities, textual genesis and literary-historical analysis.

Read more about the position here

Sülearvutite ja elektroonika remondi spetsialist

Tööülesanded: **Remhol OÜ (Tallinn)** otsib kogenud spetsialisti arvuti- ja elektroonikaseadmete remondiks.
Otsime **iseseisvat ja kõrge kvalifikatsiooniga spetsialisti**, kes ei tegele ainult moodulite vahetamisega, vaid oskab **diagnoosida ja remontida emaplaate komponenditasandil**. ### Peamised tööülesanded * Sülearvutite diagnostika ja remont komponenditasandil. * Rikete otsimine elektriskeemide ja boardview abil. * Toiteahelate, VRM-i, DC/DC-muundurite, MOSFET-ide, kontrollerite ja teiste sõlmede diagnostika. * Lühiste ja toiteahelate rikete leidmine. * BGA-, QFN-, QFP- ja teiste SMD-komponentide vahetamine ja jootmine. * BGA reballing. * BIOS-i diagnostika, programmeerimine ja taastamine. * Trükkplaatide kahjustuste remont, radade ja kontaktpindade taastamine. * Mikroskeemide ja teiste emaplaadi komponentide remont ja vahetamine. * Vedelikukahjustuste, mehaaniliste kahjustuste ja varasemate ebaõnnestunud remondikatsete tagajärjel tekkinud rikete diagnostika ja remont. * Mängukonsoolide, telefonide ja muu elektroonika remont, eelkõige komponenditasandil. * Vajadusel muu tehnika moodulremont. Töötingimused * Töö Tallinnas. * Töö professionaalselt varustatud remonditöökojas. * Põhisuund — sülearvutite ja emaplaatide remont. * Stabiilne töövoog. * Töötasu sõltub kandidaadi tegelikust kvalifikatsioonist ja kogemusest ning lepitakse kokku individuaalselt.

Omalt poolt pakume: * stabiilset ja konkurentsivõimelist töötasu;
* head ja toetavat kollektiivi; * võimalust areneda ning oma erialaseid oskusi edasi arendada; * kaasaegset ja professionaalset töökeskkonda; * stabiilset töökoormust ja mitmekesiseid remondiväljakutseid.

Muud nõuded: ### Ootame kandidaadilt
**Nõutav on reaalne kogemus component-level / board-level remondiga.** Kandidaat peab suutma iseseisvalt: * lugeda elektriskeeme ja boardview-faile; * mõista emaplaadi põhiliste sõlmede tööpõhimõtteid; * leida rikke tegeliku põhjuse, mitte lihtsalt vahetada kahtlusaluseid komponente; * töötada multimeetri, laboratoorse toiteploki, ostsilloskoobi ja jootmisseadmetega; * teha kvaliteetset SMD-jootmist; * teha BGA remonti ja reballing'ut; * diagnoosida toiteahelaid; * tuvastada sülearvuti emaplaadi rikkeid komponenditasandil. Oluline Me ei otsi algaja või kesktaseme tehnikut**, kelle põhitöö on ekraanide, klaviatuuride, akude, pistikute ja teiste moodulite vahetamine. Kui sinu tugevus on **sülearvutite emaplaatide diagnostika ja remont komponenditasandil** ning tunned end elektriskeemidega töötades kindlalt, siis soovime sinuga ühendust võtta. Tuleb kasuks * pikaajaline praktiline kogemus erinevate tootjate sülearvutite remondiga; * mänguriarvutite ja mängurisülearvutite remondi kogemus; * BGA-remondi ja reballing'u kogemus; * kaasaegsete sülearvutite skeemitehnika hea tundmine; * oskus töötada ka siis, kui valmis lahendust internetist ei leia; * vedelikukahjustustega ja tõsiselt kahjustatud emaplaatide remondi kogemus; * mängukonsoolide ja nutitelefonide komponenditasandi remondi kogemus. Keeled **Keeleoskus ei ole oluline. Eesti keele oskus ei ole sellel ametikohal vajalik.**

title: Manufacturing & Industrialisation Lead
description:
After nearly nine years of technology development, we are entering an important stage of growth. We are transitioning from low-rate engineering builds towards industrialisation, pre-series manufacturing and serial production.

Work tasks: Lead the transition from engineering builds through pre-series and into scalable serial production
Establish and scale Golbriak Space’s manufacturing, assembly, integration and testing capability in Estonia Develop repeatable production processes, routings, work instructions, acceptance criteria and engineering-to-production transfer practices Define production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures, equipment and test infrastructure Own the end-to-end manufacturing flow, from incoming inspection and material planning to final acceptance and shipping Implement production planning, capacity management, inventory control, ERP/MRP tools and relevant manufacturing metrics Oversee optical, electronic, mechanical and system-level assembly, integration, verification and testing Define and manage supplier, outsourcing and make-or-buy strategies for components and manufacturing activities Establish production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 principles, including traceability, change control and non-conformance management Identify and resolve manufacturing, testing, capacity and supply-chain risks and bottlenecks Drive continuous improvement across quality, yield, cycle time, cost and delivery performance Build, lead and develop the manufacturing and operations team as production scales

We offer: A key leadership role with ownership of Golbriak Space’s manufacturing and industrialisation function
The opportunity to build a production facility and manufacturing capability from the ground up Direct involvement in taking advanced optical communication technology into serial production Close cooperation with the founders and a multidisciplinary engineering team A high level of autonomy and the ability to shape manufacturing systems, facilities, supplier strategy and team capability An international, technically ambitious and hands-on working environment A monthly gross salary of €4,655–€5,985, depending on experience and Relocation support to Estonia if required Flexible working hours, consistent with operational and team needs

Other requirements: Proven experience establishing or significantly scaling a manufacturing facility or function
Experience transferring complex hardware products from engineering builds through pre-series and into repeatable production Hands-on experience with industrialisation, production ramp-ups, assembly, integration and testing Strong understanding of production workflows, manufacturing-process development, test infrastructure and production readiness Experience defining production layouts, workstations, tooling, fixtures and equipment requirements Experience introducing work instructions, routings, production records, traceability and configuration controls Experience with production planning, capacity analysis, inventory management, material flow and ERP/MRP systems Experience developing make-or-buy strategies and managing specialised suppliers or contract manufacturers Knowledge of structured production and quality processes aligned with ISO 9001 or an equivalent framework Understanding of non-conformance management, corrective actions and controlled engineering changes Experience building, leading and developing manufacturing or operations teams Ability to demonstrate your personal contribution and measurable results from previous industrialisation or production scale-up work Ability to operate effectively at both strategic and hands-on levels Strong cross-functional coordination, prioritisation and problem-solving skills A builder’s mindset and motivation to create new manufacturing capability Professional fluency in English Willingness to reside in Estonia and work primarily onsite in Tallinn Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate results such as establishing a production facility, transferring hardware into serial production, increasing capacity or throughput, improving quality and delivery performance, implementing manufacturing systems, developing test infrastructure, qualifying suppliers or building a production team.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Bartender
description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week
; work includes night shifts

Kandidaadilt ootame sobivaid isikuomadusi, head suhtlemisoskust, rahulikku meelt, usaldusväärsust ja valmisolekut lapse igapäevast toimetulekut toetada. Tugiisik peab: • oskama näha last tervikuna; • suutma suhelda lapse, tema pere ja lähedastega; • suutma kanda vastutust lapse ohutuse ja turvalisuse eest; • tegutsema vastavalt olukorrale; • järgima vastastikuse usalduse, lugupidamise ja konfidentsiaalsuse põhimõtteid. Tugiisik peab läbima korrapärase tervisekontrolli nakkushaiguste suhtes, sealhulgas iga kahe aasta järel kopsude röntgenuuringu. Tugiisikul peab olema tervisekontrolli läbimise kohta perearsti väljastatud tervisetõend. Tugiisikuks ei sobi inimene, kes on süüdi mõistetud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest või kes ei vasta muudele seadustes sätestatud nõuetele.

title: Scrum Master
description:
For our client from banking industry, we are looking for a Scrum Master.

The Scrum Master acts as an Execution Leader responsible not only for facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching the team, but also for actively driving the successful delivery of strategic initiatives from idea to implementation. The role combines Agile leadership, project execution, stakeholder management, delivery management, and AI enablement.

Detailed description of work task to be carried out:
Agile Leadership and Team Coaching
 Facilitate and continuously improve Agile ways of working within the team, ensuring effective execution of Scrum and SAFe practices.
 Organize and lead sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, reviews, backlog refinement sessions, PI Planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
 Coach team members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, continuous improvement, flow optimization, and value-driven delivery.
 Foster a high-performing, self-organizing, cross-functional team culture with strong collaboration, accountability, transparency, and psychological safety.
 Monitor and improve team health, engagement, predictability, quality, and delivery performance.

Initiative and Delivery Leadership:
 Take ownership of strategic initiatives, epics, features, and cross-team deliveries, acting as the primary execution leader throughout the delivery lifecycle.
 Create and maintain delivery plans, roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, risk logs, and execution tracking mechanisms
 Drive execution proactively by identifying blockers, coordinating issue resolution, escalating risks, and ensuring timely decision-making.
 Coordinate complex deliveries involving multiple teams, vendors, business stakeholders, and technology organizations.
 Ensure initiatives progress according to agreed scope, timelines, quality expectations, governance requirements, and funding constraints.
 Maintain visibility of delivery status and drive actions needed to achieve committed business outcomes.

AI Leadership and Transformation:
 Continuously identify and drive AI opportunities that improve productivity, quality, speed, and operational efficiency. Work with teams to define, prioritize, and implement AI use cases, ensuring AI and automation opportunities are considered during feature refinement, sprint planning, PI Planning, and continuous improvement activities.
 Promote an AI-first mindset across the Software Development Lifecycle by leveraging AI to improve planning, backlog management, documentation, testing, reporting, stakeholder communication, and overall team effectiveness. Encourage teams to actively challenge existing ways of working and explore how AI can simplify, automate, and accelerate value delivery

Must-have knowledge and experience:
 Experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, Project Manager, or Execution Leader in a technology-driven environment
 Strong delivery leadership, stakeholder management, and cross-team coordination capabilities
 Good understanding of API-based architectures, cloud technologies, infrastructure concepts, DevOps, and modern software development practices
 Understanding of Open Banking, digital platforms, or financial services technology ecosystems is considered a strong advantage
 Ability to engage effectively with architects, engineers, and business stakeholders without requiring hands-on technical expertise
 Proven interest in AI-driven ways of working and the ability to identify and drive adoption of AI, automation, and productivity-enhancing solutions across teams

Nice-to-have knowledge and experience:
 Experience working in financial services, banking, payments, Open Banking, Embedded Banking

title: Project Engineer – Vaasa
description:
About the role

In this position, you will become part of a close-knit and experienced team of experts. We are looking for a long-term addition to the team: someone for whom this role offers an inspiring next step in their career, and who wants to thrive and grow in the position for years to come.

What We Offer You
- Salary: Approximately €2,800 – €3,500/month depending on your experience and background.
- A long-term career path: We offer a role where you are invested in and where you can genuinely deepen your professional skills over the long term.
- Responsibility and freedom: Once you prove your skills, you will have the freedom to independently drive your projects to completion.
- Comprehensive support: Although we expect an ability to work independently, you will not be left alone. Your supervisor and a team of top professionals will support your success, especially during the onboarding phase in the first few months.

Work tasks

Your role is not pure design work in front of a screen; instead, you will act as a dynamic technical coordinator. Working as the Project Manager's right hand, you will be responsible for the technical success of energy plant lifecycle upgrades and automation retrofits in accordance with contract specifications.
- Guide and supervise design work, review electrical and automation drawings, and ensure the technical correctness of procurements.
- Act as a knowledgeable link between designers, logistics, subcontractors, and international customers.
- Depending on the size of the projects, you may manage several (max. 10) smaller automation upgrades simultaneously or extensive plant retrofit projects (from foundations up to the MV side).

What We Are Looking For

In this role, technical theory alone is not enough; you need a professional approach and strong drive to push things forward. You are no longer a complete beginner—you have already gained valuable experience and now want to take on broader responsibility.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to have:
- A solid professional foundation: You hold a relevant technical degree (e.g., Electrical or Automation Engineering, B.Sc. or M.Sc.) and previous work experience (e.g., a few years) in industry, commissioning, field service, or automation projects.
- The right personality: You are stress-tolerant and understand that the project world evolves daily. You are a proactive expert who also knows how to justify technical choices constructively and firmly.
- Language skills: Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory. Finnish language skills are considered a major asset in teamwork.

Vaasa is the Heart of This Role

This is a role where you grow into an expert and solve challenges together with the team on site. We strongly believe that the deepest expertise and best support are transferred most effectively when working alongside more experienced colleagues. Therefore, we expect you to work mainly at the Vaasa office. We are not looking for a remote worker for this position, but rather a team player who enjoys communal daily life on site. The position also includes occasional travel to global customer sites (estimated at approx. 30 travel days per year).

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: BIM Coordinator, Granlund
description:
**Looking for a role where you can take ownership of BIM coordination in large-scale construction projects? We are now looking for a BIM Coordinator to join Granlund!**

**_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be our new BIM Coordinator?**

As a BIM Coordinator, you will take responsibility for the technical coordination and quality assurance of BIM models across a variety of construction projects, including data center, commercial, and residential developments. Acting as the project's BIM expert, you will ensure that models meet project requirements and support smooth collaboration between all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Your responsibilities include coordinating BIM activities, leading model review meetings, and ensuring the technical quality of BIM models throughout different project phases. You will also support designers and project teams with BIM-related questions and help ensure that project requirements are met consistently across all disciplines.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, who is primarily involved during the early phases of the project. As the project progresses, you will take primary responsibility for its technical responsibilities. You will typically work on several projects simultaneously, supporting Project Managers, designers, contractors, and clients throughout different project phases while acting as a key link between stakeholders.

The position is a full-time and permanent role, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers a highly flexible working model with the possibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland. You may also work from any Granlund office according to your own preference. Occasional travel to project sites across Finland is expected as part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a BIM professional who can work independently and confidently guide projects through BIM-related matters. You have at least two years of experience in BIM coordination and understand how construction projects progress from design through execution. Experience in commercial construction projects is particularly valuable, while experience in data center projects is considered an advantage.

A relevant educational background in construction or engineering is required. Strong Solibri expertise is essential for success in this role, while experience with Navisworks and Revit is a plus. BIM Coordinator certification is an advantage, but not required. Most importantly, you understand BIM processes and can ensure the technical quality of project models. You communicate fluently in both Finnish and English.

As a person, you are proactive, analytical, and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You are able to work independently when needed, but also collaborate effectively with others. You have the confidence to raise issues, challenge assumptions, and communicate openly when challenges arise.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

The monthly salary for this position is approximately 4000 euros, depending on the candidate's experience and skills.

**Are you interested?**

Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 25.9.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (**nea.repo@biisoni.fi**).

title: Combat Management System Integrator, Saab Finland, Turku/Rauma
description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Tässä roolissa tulet osallistumaan Saabin 9LV taistelujohtojärjestelmän käyttöönottoon Raumalla vuosina 2026-2029 osana Laivue 2020 -hanketta. Combat Management System Integraattorina vastaat siitä, että Saab 9LV -taistelunjohtojärjestelmä (CMS) toimii yhtenä kokonaisuutena muiden taistelujärjestelmän (CS) alijärjestelmien, kuten sensoreiden, tutkien, luotaimien ja asejärjestelmien kanssa. Työssäsi huolehdit Saab 9LV CMS järjestelmän testausvalmiuden saavuttamisesta laivoilla yhdessä Saabin tiimin kanssa. Teet lisäksi tarvittaessa vianrajaus- ja selvitystöitä sekä integrointi-, suorituskyky- ja hyväksymistestausta. Pääset myös käyttöönottamaan järjestelmien uusia ohjelmistoversioita.

Toimit tiiviissä yhteistyössä Saabin testaus-, ohjelmistokehitys- ja asiakasorganisaatioiden sekä myös muiden järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa. Et ole yksin tässä roolissa vaan sinulla on vertaistukena muut CMS integraattorit niin Suomessa kuin Ruotsissa.

Työtehtävään perehtyminen tapahtuu vuoden 2026 aikana Tampereella ja Turussa. Perehtymisen aikana pääasiallinen työssäkäyntipaikkasi tulee olemaan Tampere, jossa toivomme sinun pystyvän työskentelemään noin puolet työviikosta. Turkuun suuntautuvia työmatkoja tulee olemaan arviolta joka toinen tai kolmas viikko.

Käyttöottovaiheessa pääasiallinen työssäkäyntipaikkasi tulee olemaan Rauma, jossa pääset käyttämään oppimiasi taitoja yhdessä muun Saabin käyttöönottotiimin kanssa.

Tarjoamme
- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä Suomen merkittävimmissä merivoimien modernisointihankkeissa
- Pitkäksi aikaa mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä – projektit jatkuvat vuosia
- Kansainvälisen ja teknisesti huippuluokan ympäristön
- Työn, jossa yhdistyvät ohjelmistot, sulautetut järjestelmät, verkot ja käytännön integraatiotyö

Työtehtävät
- Testausvalmiuden saavuttaminen
- Vianselvitys ja viasta palautuminen, teknisten ongelmien korjaus
- Tietojen kerääminen vikojen ja löydösten raportointia varten
- Integrointi-, kuormitus/suorituskyky- ja hyväksymistestaus
- CS/CMS-järjestelmien käyttöönotto ja integraatiotyö laivoilla ja tukikohdissa
- Yhteistyö testinsuorittajien, kehitystiimien ja kansainvälisten kollegoiden kanssa

Etsimme

- Soveltuva koulutustausta (esim. järjestelmä-, ohjelmisto- tai automaatiotekniikka)
- Kokemusta Linux komentorivin ja Dockerin käytöstä sekä tietoverkoista ja verkkolaitteista
- Valmius työskennellä konkreettisissa ympäristöissä, joissa yhdistyy ohjelmisto, laitteisto ja verkot
- Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halu toimia asiakasrajapinnassa
- Matkustusvalmius erityisesti Raumalle ja Turkuun
- Sujuva suomi ja englanti

Arvostamme, jos sinulla on seuraavaa osaamista
- IP/Ethernet-verkot ja verkkoteknologiat
- Verkkoliikenteen analysointityökalut
- Hajautetut järjestelmät ja tietoväylät
- Tietokone- ja palvelinlaitteisto
- Git, Artifactory tai vastaava
- CI/CD-ympäristöt
- Kokemusta Jirasta tai vastaavasta tikettijärjestelmästä
- Ruotsin kielen osaaminen

Menestyäksesi roolissa olet:
- Oppimishaluinen, utelias ja aidosti kiinnostunut monimutkaisista teknisistä järjestelmistä
- Rauhallinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen myös epävarmuutta sisältävissä tilanteissa
- Oma-aloitteinen ja systemaattinen – nautit siitä, että asiat toimivat ja pysyvät hallinnassa
- Kommunikoit sujuvasti eri sidosryhmien kanssa ja viihdyt käytännönläheisessä projektityössä

Tehtävään valittavalle henkilölle teetetään turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetestit.

Rekrytointiprosessimme

Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

title: Production Coordinator, Konecranes
description:
**We are now looking for a Production Coordinator to join Konecranes' global delivery organization and support customer delivery projects worldwide.**

_Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs._

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued._

**Would you be our new Production Coordinator?**

As a Production Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials, information and deliveries move smoothly throughout customer delivery projects. Working as part of an international team, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in engineering, procurement, logistics, quality and project management to keep projects progressing according to plan. The role offers a unique opportunity to gain a broad understanding of how global delivery projects are executed from planning and procurement to final delivery.

Your daily work includes creating purchase requisitions in SAP, maintaining bill of materials (BOM) structures, coordinating shipments and supporting material availability throughout project deliveries. As projects evolve, new requirements and unexpected situations naturally arise. Your role is to keep things moving forward by coordinating activities, communicating with stakeholders and proactively resolving potential issues.

You will also work with technical documentation such as drawings and parts lists. While you do not need to be an experienced engineer, you should feel comfortable interpreting technical information and understanding how different components fit together within a project.

This is a full-time and permanent position. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. The role follows a flexible hybrid working model, combining remote work with regular weekly office days in Hyvinkää. Occasional international travel may be part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

Whether you are a recent graduate or have already gained a few years of experience, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in project deliveries, logistics and supply chain operations within a global industrial company.

You may have gained experience through studies, internships or previous work in areas such as supply chain management, project coordination, logistics, production planning or procurement. A background in industrial engineering and management, mechanical engineering, logistics or another relevant field is beneficial, but we are primarily looking for motivation, learning agility and a proactive mindset.

To succeed in this role, you should have strong general IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools. Strong communication skills in English are required, as English is the working language in this role. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

As a person, you are organized, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions when plans change. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment and collaborating with stakeholders from different backgrounds and cultures.

**Why us?**

This role offers a great opportunity to learn how global customer delivery projects and supply chains operate in practice. You will gain exposure to multiple business functions and develop valuable expertise while working alongside experienced professionals in an international environment.

At Konecranes, you will be supported by a collaborative team culture where questions are encouraged, knowledge is shared openly and colleagues help each other succeed. The role also provides excellent opportunities for future career development across the company.

**Have we got your interest?**

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.9.2026. We process applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant via email at **saija.salter@biisoni.fi**

title: Lead Infrastructure Architect
description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens IT-infrastruktur för det offentliga Åland?

Åda söker en Lead Infrastructure Architect – en erfaren teknisk specialist som vill kombinera tekniskt djup med arkitektur, helhetsperspektiv och långsiktig utveckling.

Åda levererar och utvecklar IT-tjänster för den offentliga sektorn på Åland. Våra tekniska miljöer omfattar allt från nätverk, datacenter och serverplattformar till molntjänster, identitet, klienthantering och säkerhet.

I takt med att våra tjänster och kundmiljöer utvecklas behöver vi stärka vår förmåga att arbeta långsiktigt och sammanhållet med den tekniska arkitekturen.

Därför söker vi nu dig som vill vara med och forma den tekniska riktningen framåt.

**Om rollen**

Som Lead Infrastructure Architect får du en central roll i utvecklingen av Ådas tekniska plattformar och infrastruktur.

Du arbetar med helheten och bidrar till att våra tekniska miljöer utvecklas på ett sammanhängande, säkert och långsiktigt hållbart sätt.

Rollen spänner från övergripande målarkitektur och arkitekturprinciper till lösningsarkitektur och komplexa tekniska vägval. Du kommer att vara en viktig teknisk kraft i större initiativ och bidra till att skapa struktur, samsyn och långsiktig riktning för Ådas tekniska miljöer.

**I rollen kommer du bland annat att**

- utveckla och förvalta övergripande målarkitektur för IT-infrastruktur och tekniska plattformar

- utveckla arkitekturprinciper och referensarkitekturer samt bidra till teknisk standardisering

- skapa sammanhang mellan olika tekniska plattformar, tjänster och lösningar

- leda och stödja arkitekturarbetet i större och tvärgående initiativ

- genomföra arkitektur- och designgranskningar

- bidra till strategiska tekniska vägval och beslutsunderlag

- identifiera teknisk skuld, beroenden och långsiktiga utvecklingsbehov

- bidra med arkitekturkompetens i projekt, upphandlingar och kravställning

- bidra till att tekniska lösningar är säkra, robusta, skalbara och möjliga att drifta och utveckla över tid

- identifiera möjligheter till konsolidering, standardisering, automatisering och effektivisering

- följa teknikutvecklingen och omsätta relevanta möjligheter till konkreta rekommendationer.


**Vem söker vi?**

Vi söker dig som har bred erfarenhet av modern IT-infrastruktur och samtidigt förmågan att lyfta blicken och se helheten. Du har god förståelse för flera delar av den moderna IT-miljön, exempelvis nätverk, server- och datacenterinfrastruktur, molntjänster, identitet, klientplattformar och informationssäkerhet.

Du behöver inte vara den främsta specialisten inom varje teknik. Däremot behöver du förstå hur olika tekniska områden påverkar varandra och kunna omsätta verksamhetsbehov, säkerhetskrav och tekniska möjligheter till en sammanhängande arkitektur.

**Vi tror att du**

- har gedigen erfarenhet av komplexa IT-miljöer

- har arbetat med teknisk arkitektur, lösningsdesign eller motsvarande

- har ett starkt intresse för både teknik och långsiktig utveckling

- kan växla mellan strategiska frågor och tekniska detaljer

- har lätt för att strukturera komplexa problem och skapa tydliga tekniska vägval

- kommunicerar tekniska frågor på ett begripligt sätt

- trivs med att samarbeta och driva tekniska frågor över flera områden.

- Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift


Erfarenhet av exempelvis Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, virtualisering, nätverksarkitektur, hybridmiljöer, säkerhetsarkitektur eller tekniska upphandlingar är meriterande.

**En möjlighet att påverka på riktigt**

Det här är en roll för dig som vill ha ett stort tekniskt inflytande och arbeta med frågor som sträcker sig över hela IT-miljön.

Hos Åda får du vara med och forma hur gemensamma tekniska plattformar och tjänster för det offentliga Åland ska utvecklas under kommande år.

Du får arbeta både långsiktigt och nära tekniken – från målarkitektur och arkitekturprinciper till konkreta lösningar och tekniska vägval.

**Anställningsvillkor**

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med start enligt överenskommelse. Prövotid om sex månader tillämpas. Säkerhetsutredning enligt säkerhetsutredningslagen (726/2014) genomförs som villkor för anställning.

**Placering**

Mariehamn, Åland

**Ansökan**

Välkommen med din ansökan, CV och löneanspråk senast den 30 september 2026. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.

title: Senior Project Planner
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

title: Administratör, tillsvidare 80-100%
description:
Är du noggrann, ansvarstagande med god initiativförmåga? Har du intresse för löneräkning och kan eller vill lära dig mer om kommunala kollektivavtal och lönebestämmelser? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

**Om tjänsten**

Som administratör med fokus på löneräkning hos Finströms kommun har du en viktig roll i att säkerställa att våra medarbetare får rätt lön i rätt tid. Du räknar även lön åt våra bolag och samarbetskommuner. Totalt sett ungefär 220 utbetalningar per månad.

Arbetet innebär att du hanterar löneunderlag från kommunens olika verksamheter och ser till att uppgifterna är kompletta och korrekta innan lönekörning. Du behöver därför ha tålamod med att kontrollera, följa upp och ibland återkomma till verksamheterna för att få underlagen rätt.

Du arbetar med löner enligt kommunala kollektivavtal och andra bestämmelser som påverkar lönehanteringen. Arbetet kräver att du är beredd att sätta dig in i och kontinuerligt lära dig nya regler, avtal och rutiner.

Som löneräknare arbetar du både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor inom ekonomi och HR. Du behöver kunna ta emot direktiv och arbeta enligt fastställda rutiner, samtidigt som du vågar ställa frågor när något är oklart eller inte stämmer.

**Vi söker dig som:**

- har en relevant utbildning och gedigen erfarenhet av lönehantering.

- är mycket noggrann och har öga för detaljer

- tar ansvar för att dina arbetsuppgifter blir korrekt utförda

- är uthållig och inte ger upp när underlagen behöver kontrolleras eller kompletteras

- tycker om rutiner, struktur och ordning

- har intresse för löner och vill förstå hur löner och ersättningar ska hanteras

- är intresserad av att lära dig kommunala kollektivavtal och de regler som styr lönehanteringen

- kan följa givna direktiv och fastställda rutiner

- har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera med kollegor och verksamheter

- har god datorvana och lätt för att lära dig digitala system

- Erfarenhet av Abilitas löneprogram är meriterande


**Vi erbjuder:**

- En tillsvidareanställning på 80-100 % av heltid från 19.10.2026 eller enligt överenskommelse. Lön enligt lönesättningspunkt 01TOI060 3 542,26 (100%)

- Arbetstid enligt byråarbetstid, 36,25 h/vecka (vid 100 %).

- En självständig och ansvarsfull roll i en stimulerande arbetsmiljö.

title: Service Project Manager
description:
**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Service Project Manager to join our Service Business Unit at Hitachi Energy in Finland. In this role, you will work in a hybrid setup, combining remote work, office-based work, and regularly site visits. You will oversee maintenance and service activities, review work on-site, and, when required, take an active role in leading and supporting maintenance work in the field. Regular customer meetings, project reviews, and stakeholder communication are also key aspects of the position.

The primary location for this role is Lappeenranta, Vaasa, or Vantaa, although other locations in Finland may be considered based on the candidate's qualifications. Travel is primarily within Finland.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

\- Managing service agreements with customers.

\- Providing sales and maintenance services related to power distribution in cooperation with Service Sales.

\- Acting as Project Manager for service projects.

\- Providing high-end specialist services.

\- Establishing long-term customer relationships by understanding customers' needs and demonstrating in-depth technical service solutions knowledge.

\- Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring a seamless and positive customer experience.

\- Building trust and maintaining sustainable relationships with customers by handling and coordinating warranty jobs, ensuring continuous communication and connecting them with our sales team.

**Your background**

\- B.Sc. in electrical engineering and relevant experience with power systems or other suitable education and vast experience with power systems.

\- Service oriented person with solution-oriented approach.

\- Basic IT skills as well as the ability to learn modern engineering applications.

\- High integrity and a strong safety first mindset.

\- Experience from power system service / maintenance.

\- Electrical Qualification Level 1, or eligibility to obtain the required certification is an advantage.

\- Understanding power quality, relay protection and communication is an advantage.

\- Understanding the basics of substation design is seen as an advantage.

\- Knowledge of commercial contracts is an advantage.

\- Excellent written and spoken skills in Finnish. Basic skills in English.

\- Quality-focused, customer-oriented team player who is willing to commit to long-term objectives and development.

\- Valid drivers license.

title: Asiakaspalvelija –liity Valoon tiimiin!
description:
Nautitko ihmisten auttamisesta ja mutkattoman asiakaspalvelun tarjoamisesta? Haluatko olla osa kasvavaa yritystä, jossa asiakaskokemus on kaiken keskiössä? Etsimme uusia asiakaspalvelijoita tuottamaan erinomaisia kohtaamisia Valoon asiakkaille osana motivoitunutta tiimiä.

Valonnopeudella kasvava Valoo on valokuitumarkkinoiden raikkain ja rohkein toimija, joka tuo laadukkaat, nopeat ja kestävät valokuituyhteydet yhä useampaan suomalaiseen kotiin. Asiakkaille tarjoamme markkinoiden parhaan nettiyhteyden - työntekijöille innostavan, lämpimän ja merkityksellisen työympäristön.

Mitä työpäivääsi kuuluu

Asiakaspalvelijana päätehtäväsi on asiakkaiden kontaktoiminen informatiivisella ja ystävällisellä otteella, asiakaspalvelun kasvoina toimiminen eri yhteydenpitokanavissa sekä luonnollisesti Valoon palveluiden myynti. Sinulla on tärkeä rooli Valoon ilosanoman jalkauttamisessa ja laadukkaan asiakaskokemuksen tuottamisessa. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti Seinäjoen toimistolta käsin ja työpäiväsi sijoittuvat arkipäivisin klo 9-17 ja lauantaisin klo 10-16 väliselle ajalle.

Mitä toivomme sinulta

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista osaamista asiakaspalvelun laadun varmistamiseksi
- Positiivista ja rentoa palveluasennetta - tavoitteenasi on tuottaa mieleenpainuva asiakaskokemus
- Hyvää tilannetajua sekä kiinnostusta asiakasta kohtaan
- Tavoitteellista suhtautumista asiakaspalveluun
- Kykyä toimia erilaisissa vuorovaikutustilanteissa ja kuunnella asiakasta aidosti
- Iloista ja ratkaisukeskeistä lähestymistapaa
Aikaisempi kokemus asiakaspalvelusta on eduksesi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme hyvää tyyppiä oikealla asenteella.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

- Paikan kasvavassa yrityksessä ja reippaassa, rempseässä työporukassa
- Joustavan työn, jossa arvostetaan yhdessä tekemisen meininkiä
- Kattavan koulutuksen tehtävään -sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis ammattilainen
- Uudet ja raikkaat toimitilat inspiroivassa työympäristössä Seinäjoen keskustassa
- ICT-alan TES:n mukaisen kuukausipalkan 2 184,90 € / kk (osa-aikaisen tuntipalkka 13,83 €) sekä kannustavan bonusjärjestelmän
- Baronan työterveyspalvelut sekä lounasetu
Etsimme tiimiimme kokoaikaista (37,5 h/vko) asiakaspalvelijaa. Työvuorot sijoittuvat asiakaspalvelumme aukioloaikojen mukaisesti. Työt alkavat mahdollisimman pian sopivan henkilön löydyttyä!

Jätäthän hakemuksen pikimmiten, sillä käsittelemme hakemuksia koko rekrytointiprosessin ajan!

Rekrytointiin liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaa Baronan henkilöstökonsultti Anni Kivimäki, anni.kivimaki@barona.fi.

title: Johtava tietoarkkitehti
description:
Konsernipalvelujen toimiala, Talouspalvelut
Tiedolla johtamisen yksikkö
Neilikkatie 17 , 01300 Vantaa

Me VAKEssa rakennamme yhdessä rohkeasti hyvinvointialuetta, johon asukkaamme voivat luottaa. Haluamme olla vakaa edelläkävijä, joka uudistaa toimintaa avoimesti ja ihmislähtöisesti. Arvomme oikeudenmukaisuus, vastuullisuus ja rohkeus ohjaavat arjen työtämme. Tunnistatko näistä myös omat arvosi?

Tule sinäkin Hyvantekijät-joukkueeseemme!

Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue etsii johtavaa tietoarkkitehtia tiedolla johtamisen yksikköön vastaamaan erityisesti tiedolla johtamisen tietoarkkitehtuurin kokonaisuudesta ja sen pitkäjänteisestä kehittämisestä. Määrittelet tehtävässä mm. tietoalustan tietoarkkitehtuurin nyky- ja tavoitetilan, periaatteet, linjaukset ja standardit sekä ohjaat tietoalustan teknistä ja strategista kehittämistä.

Varmistat tehtävässäsi myös terveydenhuollon, sosiaalihuollon ja hallinnon tietomallien yhteentoimivuutta, sekä koordinoit tietojen mallinnusta ja tiedon laadun kehittämistä osana tiedolla johtamisen tiimiä.

Viet alustan teknisiä kehityshankkeita itsenäisesti eteenpäin ja toimit tiedolla johtamisen yksikön johtavana asiantuntijana tietoalustaan, tietovirtoihin, tietomalleihin, tiedon laatuun ja metatietoon liittyvissä kysymyksissä. Arvioit tehtävässä myös kehityshankkeiden ja uusien ratkaisujen vaikutuksia tietoalustan rakenteeseen, tietomalleihin, tiedon laatuun ja ylläpidettävyyteen sekä teet tarvittaessa poikkileikkaavia arkkitehtuuriratkaisuja.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiantuntijoiden, johdon, kehityshankkeiden ja teknologiakumppaneiden kanssa ja rakennat toimintamalleja, jotka mahdollistavat hallitun, laadukkaan ja skaalautuvan datan hyödyntämisen.

Odotamme

- Vahvaa kokemusta tietoarkkitehtuurista ja modernien tietoalustojen kehittämisestä
- Osaamista tietomallinnuksesta, tietovarastoinnista ja tietovirroista
- Kykyä hahmottaa laajoja teknisiä datakokonaisuuksia ja niiden riippuvuuksia
- Kokemusta Lakehouse-, Data Warehouse- ja Medallion-arkkitehtuureista
- Kokemusta moderneista pilviarkkitehtuuriratkaisuista

Arvostamme

- Kokemusta data governancesta sekä metadataratkaisuista
- Kokemusta työskentelystä Azure/Microsoft Fabric tietoalustojen kanssa
- Ymmärrystä ja kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon tietojen käsittelystä, tietomalleista tai tietojärjestelmistä

Työskentelet tehtävässä tiedolla johtamisen yksikössä, jonka toimisto sijaitsee Tikkurilassa. Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueella on käytössä hybridityömalli, joten voit työskennellä osittain myös etänä.

Miksi Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialue?

Meillä hyvinvointi ja arjen sujuvuus ovat aidosti tärkeitä. Tarjoamme lounasedun sekä 400 euron Epassi-edun liikuntaan, kulttuuriin, hyvinvointiin tai työmatkoihin. Lisäksi hyvinvointiasi tukevat lakisääteiset työterveyspalvelumme.

Olemme ihmisläheinen organisaatio, jossa kehitämme toimintaa rohkeasti ja yhdessä. Meillä johtaminen on lupaus selkeistä tavoitteista, arvostavasta kohtaamisesta ja rohkeasta yhdessä uudistamisesta.

Saat selkeän näkymän omaan työhösi sekä mahdollisuuksia kokeilla ja kehittää uusia tapoja tehdä työtä. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia myös oman osaamisesi vahvistamiseen ja urasi kehittämiseen. Teemme merkityksellistä työtä joka päivä: autamme, hoidamme ja pelastamme.

title: Product Engineer (Mechanical Design), Dieffenbacher / Lahti, Nastola
description:
About the role

Dieffenbacher is a German, globally operating machinery manufacturer focusing on the design and manufacture of press systems and complete production lines for the panel industry.

In this role, you will play a key part as a member of a \~20-person mechanical design team in Nastola. You will be responsible for specific equipment entities and perform related design work. You will work in close cooperation with automation designers and the chief mechanical designer to ensure projects progress smoothly. Additionally, you will guide external consultants and ensure the quality of the work.

Every project brings something new, giving you the opportunity to challenge yourself with new practices and possibilities.

Why Join Us?
Our mechanical engineering relies strongly on our own expert know-how and a broad network of specialists. We offer you a responsible and diverse role where you can solve interesting technical challenges. With us, you will work in a close-knit atmosphere from the drafting board straight into practice.

Work tasks
- Equipment Responsibility: You will be responsible for designated equipment packages, overseeing equipment improvements, cost tracking, supporting project planning, and equipment documentation.
- Design: You will design custom customer assignments (heavy structures) using Creo & AutoCAD.
- Quality Assurance and Partner Guidance: You will direct design work done by consultants and ensure the output meets high quality standards.
- Practical Collaboration and Inspections: You will collaborate with the workshops, automation design, and R&D, perform equipment inspections, and communicate with customers as needed.
- Fieldwork: You will participate in troubleshooting at installation sites when necessary (site visits approx. 5–15 days per year).

We are looking for

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.
- Solid design experience (preferably over 4 years) in heavy structures (1–20 t), machinery, and machine parts manufactured by welding or machining.
- Fluent English skills.
- Ability to work full-time at the Nastola office during the trial period. Option for 2 remote workdays per week after the trial period.
- Readiness to travel abroad approx. 5–15 days per year.
- Accountability, a proactive and precise working style, and good interpersonal skills.

Considered an Advantage:
- Good proficiency in Finnish.
- Understanding the requirements and possibilities of different manufacturing methods.
- Experience in structural strength calculations and motor sizing.
- Previous hands-on experience in welding or installation work.

 

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentaja, Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab, Turku
description:

Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajana vastaat tuotantolaitteiden ja automaatiojärjestelmien toimivuudesta ja kehittämisestä. Työ on monipuolinen ja sisältää sekä kunnossapidon että tuotannon kehittämisen tehtäviä.

**Tehtävänkuva**

· Mekaanisten ja sähköautomaatioon liittyvien vikojen korjaus sekä häiriöiden poisto koko tuotannon ja logistiikan alueella

· Ennakkohuoltojen toteutus

· Tuotantolinjojen kehittäminen ja parantaminen yhteistyössä esihenkilösi, muiden tuotantoasentajien sekä kunnossapitoasentajien kanssa

**Edellytämme sinulta**

· Sähkö- ja automaatioalan ammatillista koulutusta tai riittävää kokemusta teollisuuden automaatiotehtävistä

· Halua ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

· Hyviä ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

· Yhteistyökykyä muun henkilöstömme sekä urakoitsijoiden henkilöstön kanssa

Sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan osaaminen on tehtävässä keskeinen perusvaatimus. Yrityksellä on mahdollisuus perehdyttää ja kouluttaa tehtävän mekaanisiin osa-alueisiin sekä laitteisiin, mutta sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan perustaidot tulisi hakijalla olla jo valmiiksi hallussa.

**Tarjoamme**

· Vakituisen työn kansainvälisessä yrityksessä kaikkien suomalaisten tuntemien tuotebrändien parissa

· Yrityksen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisen palkkauksen, kattavan sairaskuluvakuutuksen sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun

· Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän modernissa tuotantoympäristössä

· Hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä työssäsi

**Palkkaus**

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on 15,13 €/h - 18,20 €/h. Huomioimme palkkauksessa henkilön osoittaman osaamisen sekä työkokemuksen. Lisäksi palkkaukseen vaikuttavat TES:n mukaiset ilta- ja yötyölisät, yrityskohtainen kolmivuorolisä sekä työsuhteen aikana osoitettu monityötaitoisuus.

_Työkuutio toimii rekrytoinnissa Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n kumppanina. Pyydämme lähettämään hakemuksen ja CV:n osoitteeseen toimisto@tyokuutio.fi viimeistään 10.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme hakemusten läpikäynnin ja haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä – toimi siis ripeästi!_

title: Försäljingsförhandlare
description:
