title: Network Architect
description:
Are you an experienced network professional with a strong architectural mindset and passion for secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions?

**We are looking for a Network Architect** to take responsibility for the design, implementation, and strategic development of Outokumpus global network infrastructure.

**In this role**, you will ensure that our network solutions are aligned with business objectives, security standards, and future technology needs. You will provide technical guidance across network technologies and support both operational activities and transformation initiatives. **As a Network Architect**, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the overall view of Outokumpus network architecture, covering areas such as LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, external access, IP services, and cloud connectivity.

You will work closely with IT teams, business stakeholders, partners, and projects to define target architecture, guide solution design, and ensure that global network standards and technologies are followed.

**In this role, you will:**

- Develop and maintain the current Network Architecture view, covering LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, external access, and IP services

- Define network standards, policies, and best practices

- Create, maintain, and drive short-term and long-term network roadmaps aligned with IT and business needs

- Develop and uphold the target Outokumpu Network Architecture, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities

- Support key partners in designing and implementing network solutions

- Guide IT programmes and projects towards the agreed target architecture

- Define and maintain consistent processes to ensure global technologies and standards are followed

- Identify and evaluate new technologies and innovations in the network market

- Own network documentation and develop processes for its review and lifecycle management

- Ensure network designs comply with security standards and regulatory requirements

- Design network solutions across cloud platforms


We are looking for a candidate with strong technical expertise, architectural thinking, and the ability to translate business requirements into practical, secure, and cost-effective solutions.

**To succeed in this role, you should have:**

- More than 7 years of experience in network technologies, solutions, and security

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant field or equivalent experience

- In-depth knowledge of networking and network security concepts, protocols, and technologies

- Experience with traditional and cloud computing environments, including legacy technologies

- Experience with Microsoft Azure is considered an advantage

- Understanding of industry-specific production and OT environments

- Experience with Palo Alto and Aruba hardware and tools

- Ability to translate business requirements into cost-effective technical solutions

- Experience with Enterprise Architecture processes and tools

- Strong conceptual, functional, and technical skills

- Willingness and flexibility to travel based on business needs


**Why join us?** At Outokumpu, you will have the opportunity to work in an international environment and contribute to the development of secure, modern, and business-critical network services. You will play an important role in shaping the future of our global network architecture and supporting digital transformation across the company. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact in a global industrial environment, we would be happy to hear from you.

**Please submit your application and CV in English** before the 4th of October via our website.

**For more information about the role,** please contact Sam Kurdynowski, Head of Compute and Networks, Sam.Kurdynowski@outokumpu.com.

title: Projektmedarbetare till vårt arbete med barn och familjer
description:
Vi rekryterar en medarbetare till vårt team för förebyggande familjearbete i Pargas för perioden 1.10.26-31.7.27. Arbetets huvudsakliga uppgift är att arbeta inom projektet **Hav och Hem – föräldrafärdigheter för en trygg vardag och bättre barndom i skärgården**.

Vi erbjuder dig

- Ett intressant och mångsidigt arbete med fokus på att stärka föräldraskap, familjers välmående och barns uppväxtvillkor.

- Arbete är självständigt, men det finns ett mångprofessionellt team som du är del av.

- Varierande arbetsuppgifter.


**Vad är Hav och Hem?**

Hav och Hem är ett tvåårigt utvecklingsprojekt (1.8.25-31.7.27) som stärker föräldraskap, familjers resiliens och tillgången till stöd i Pargas och på Kimitoön. Projektet riktar sig till svensk-, finsk- och flerspråkiga familjer med barn i åldern 0–18 år samt till professionella som möter föräldrar i sitt arbete. Målet är att stärka familjers resurser i vardagen och bidra till en trygg barndom i skärgården. Projektet finansieras av Leadergruppen I samma båt rf och Svenska kulturfonden.

**I arbetet ingår att**

- genomföra individuell föräldrahandledning,

- planera och leda gruppverksamhet för föräldrar,

- samarbeta med professionella och aktörer i regionen,

- planera och genomföra informationstillfällen, nätverksträffar och familjeevenemang,

- utveckla och producera material för föräldrastöd och kommunikation,

- dokumentera, följa upp och utvärdera verksamheten,

- delta i kommunikation och marknadsföring av projektet,

- delta i projektets avslutande skede och bidra till att resultat, erfarenheter och lärdomar tas tillvara.


**Vi förutsätter att du har**

- Lämplig högskoleutbildning inom social- och hälsovård.

- God samarbetsförmåga och goda kommunikationsfärdigheter.

- Förmåga att arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och initiativrikt.

- Ett professionellt och respektfullt bemötande i mötet med familjer och samarbetspartner.

- Berömliga muntliga och skriftliga kunskaper i svenska och finska.


**Som merit räknas**

- Erfarenhet av arbete med barn, unga och familjer.

- Erfarenhet av föräldrastöd, handledning eller gruppverksamhet.

- Kunskap om eller erfarenhet av evidensbaserade föräldrastödsprogram.


Arbetsplatsen är Pargas, men arbetet är rörligt och utförs i Pargas och på Kimitoön, vilket förutsätter körkort och möjlighet att använda egen bil i arbetet.

Som arbetsförmåner erbjuder vi Smartum Pay (kultur-, motions- och massageförmån), två åkband per år till Borgbackens nöjespark, arbetsvälmående- och personaldagar samt företagshälsovård.

Intervjuerna påbörjas under ansökningstiden och befattningen fylls genast då vi hittar en lämplig kandidat.

title: Production Coordinator, Konecranes
description:
**We are now looking for a Production Coordinator to join Konecranes' global delivery organization and support customer delivery projects worldwide.**

_Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs._

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued._

**Would you be our new Production Coordinator?**

As a Production Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials, information and deliveries move smoothly throughout customer delivery projects. Working as part of an international team, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in engineering, procurement, logistics, quality and project management to keep projects progressing according to plan. The role offers a unique opportunity to gain a broad understanding of how global delivery projects are executed from planning and procurement to final delivery.

Your daily work includes creating purchase requisitions in SAP, maintaining bill of materials (BOM) structures, coordinating shipments and supporting material availability throughout project deliveries. As projects evolve, new requirements and unexpected situations naturally arise. Your role is to keep things moving forward by coordinating activities, communicating with stakeholders and proactively resolving potential issues.

You will also work with technical documentation such as drawings and parts lists. While you do not need to be an experienced engineer, you should feel comfortable interpreting technical information and understanding how different components fit together within a project.

This is a full-time and permanent position. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. The role follows a flexible hybrid working model, combining remote work with regular weekly office days in Hyvinkää. Occasional international travel may be part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

Whether you are a recent graduate or have already gained a few years of experience, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in project deliveries, logistics and supply chain operations within a global industrial company.

You may have gained experience through studies, internships or previous work in areas such as supply chain management, project coordination, logistics, production planning or procurement. A background in industrial engineering and management, mechanical engineering, logistics or another relevant field is beneficial, but we are primarily looking for motivation, learning agility and a proactive mindset.

To succeed in this role, you should have strong general IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools. Strong communication skills in English are required, as English is the working language in this role. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

As a person, you are organized, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions when plans change. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment and collaborating with stakeholders from different backgrounds and cultures.

**Why us?**

This role offers a great opportunity to learn how global customer delivery projects and supply chains operate in practice. You will gain exposure to multiple business functions and develop valuable expertise while working alongside experienced professionals in an international environment.

At Konecranes, you will be supported by a collaborative team culture where questions are encouraged, knowledge is shared openly and colleagues help each other succeed. The role also provides excellent opportunities for future career development across the company.

**Have we got your interest?**

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.9.2026. We process applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant via email at **saija.salter@biisoni.fi**

title: Senior Project Planner
description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Olos
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multi talented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season.

**In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

title: Documentation Engineer, Evac Oy, Espoo
description:
About the role

You will play a key role in ensuring the documents meet project demands and are delivered to clients on time. As a working place Evac fosters an inclusive and safe culture where colleagues know and trust each other. The recently renewed purpose and vision are driving Evac towards a zero-waste future and modern and stylish office premises in Espoo offer you a new level of well-being at work!

Work tasks
- Technical writing for projects, products, and spare parts
- Document control for projects and collaborating with other document controllers
- Assisting the Lead Documentation Engineer in workload management and work assignments
- Developing best practices and improving the documentation system

We are looking for

- Bachelors or Masters degree in environmental, mechanical, or a related engineering field
- Experience in product and project documentation
- Experience in technical documentation, reporting and other engineering tasks
- Commited to provide excellent customer service
- Excellent communication skills and proactive approach to work
- Fluent written and spoken English
- Proficiency in MS Office tools

It is meritorious if you have
- Working knowledge of JIRA, Windchill, SharePoint and AutoCAD

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Lietoon
description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon – kädet saveen, liikkeelle yhdessä ja musiikki soimaan!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka ei pelkää laittaa itseään likoon – ja välillä laittaa myös musiikin soimaan.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä ihmisten kanssa – ei vain heidän puolestaan.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme jokapäiväistä elämää. Tuet heidän toimintakykyään, hyvinvointiaan ja itsenäisyyttään sekä olet mukana luomassa mielekästä arkea.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- päivätoiminnan ja yhteisen tekemisen toteuttamista

- ulkoilua, virikkeitä ja arjen pieniä iloja

- kohtaamisia asukkaiden ja heidän läheistensä kanssa

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.**

Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä asukkaidemme arkea.

Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**.

Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos ajattelet, että **tuonne minä haluaisin töihin**, älä jää vain ajattelemaan – laita hakemus tulemaan!

Kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi ja siitä, **miksi juuri sinä sopisit Kreivinkotoon.**

**Kreivinkodossa hyvä arki ei synny itsestään – tehdään se yhdessä.**

Aloitamme haastattelut jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten hae heti, niin päästään tutustumaan. Haluatko osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa kaikilla on tärkeä tehtävä ja halu menestyä yhdessä? Laita hakemuksesi Annelle (anne.holmberg@kototiimi.fi)

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

title: Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

title: Account Manager Capital Sales Ocean Division
description:
Account Manager - Ocean Division NDR



Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water and shipping.



As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too.



About the Job
As our new Account Manager Ocean Division, you will play a pivotal role in driving the company's growth by proactively identifying and pursuing new business opportunities. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast paced, customer focused environment and enjoys the challenge of building lasting relationships.



Your responsibilities will include:

    Direct sales responsibilities, ensuring customer success for your assigned accounts, handling all activities from inquiry to order.
    Generate and nurture leads, converting them into orders.
    Collaborate with the other teams such as Business Development, P&A and Service in order to grow the business.
    Engage actively with the market, focusing on customer interactions, including regular in person engagement, understanding customer needs, and delivering product and service value.
    Develop value based quotes that reflect customer needs and highlight unique selling points.
    Actively follow up on quotes to ensure the proposed value is understood and matches customer needs.
    Provide direct support to customers during the quotation process.
    Work proactively and in a structured manner within and across teams to optimize sales efficiency.
    Use CRM and other tools consistently and effectively to support the sales process and decision-making.



This position is based in one of our Nordic Sites located in Sandvika, Espoo, Søborg, Aalborg or Lund.



Who You Are

You are a proactive and driven sales professional with strong communication skills and a passion for building customer relationships. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable using digital tools, and enjoy working both independently and as part of a team. You are structured, goal-oriented, and eager to deliver value to customers while growing your career in a global company.



What You Know
To succeed in this role, we imagine you have:

    Proficiency in commercial contract management and understanding.
    Experience in field sales, account management, or a similar customer-facing role, with a proven track record of successful face-to-face customer engagement.
    High digital competence including frequent usage of CRM systems and digital communication tools.
    You understand technical products and can translate customer needs into value-based solutions.
    Excellent interpersonal skills, comfortable communicating with individuals and teams, including at senior levels.
    Strong communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language.
    You know how to work collaboratively across teams to achieve sales goals.
    Technical education, such as a bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field would be a benefit.



What We Offer

You'll be part of a small, informal team where everyone's voice matters. We work hard, but we also make sure there's room for a healthy balance in life. Teamwork is at the heart of everything we do, we support each other, share ideas, and celebrate our successes together. As part of Alfa Laval, you'll also enjoy the benefits of working in a global company, with opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from around the world, learn from diverse perspectives, and grow your career in an international environment.



What's in it for you?

You'll enjoy a challenging and rewarding role in a global, open, and supportive environment. You'll collaborate across functions, gaining broad business insights and building a valuable international network. Your contributions will be recognized, and you'll see the real impact of your work on Alfa Laval's success. As you help shape the future of our industry, you'll also have opportunities for personal and professional growth, developing your skills, expanding your horizons, and advancing your career in a company that values innovation, teamwork, and initiative.



For More Information
Please contact Ocean Capital Sales Manager Anna-Maja Eriksson

TAP, Divya Sharma



Application Deadline: Please submit your application no later than 15th September 2026



Selection and interviews will be ongoing continuously. Please be aware that the application process may close earlier if we identify suitable candidates, so do not delay in applying.



As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and secure workplace, we conduct background checks on final candidates for this role.



We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioral traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.



Applications sent directly via email will be disregarded without notice due to GDPR.

We are looking forward to your application.

title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Levi
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Saariselkä
description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

title: Research Assistant
description:
The iCell (Immune Cell Therapy Research Group) at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, invites applications for a one-year fixed-term position as a Research Assistant. Our laboratory is located at the Biomedicum 1, Helsinki.
The iCell research group at Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a dynamic research group dedicated to advancing novel immunotherapies against cancer. Our primary interest lies in the research and development of CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies, aiming at addressing current clinical needs through innovative product development.

Our research focuses on NK cell modifications, expansion, persistence, and killing efficacy. We employ various techniques, including primary cell culture, base editing, flow cytometry, lentiviral transduction, cytotoxic assays, and in vivo models.

We have an opening for a motivated Research Assistant to work on genetic modifications and gene editing of CAR-NK cells to enhance their efficacy against cancer.

Main responsibilities

Performing laboratory experiments related to immune cell engineering and characterization
Conducting cell culture, molecular biology, and gene editing procedures
Assisting in data collection and documentation
Maintaining laboratory records and inventories
Supporting laboratory organization, equipment maintenance, and general operations
Collaborating with researchers and other team members in ongoing projects

Qualifications

The successful candidate holds a relevant degree in life sciences, biotechnology, biomedicine, or a related field and has practical laboratory experience, particularly in cell culture techniques.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
Immunology
Molecular biology
Gene editing technologies
GLP/GMP-compliant laboratory work

Bioinformatics expertise is considered an additional asset when combined with experience in one or more of the areas listed above.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated and proactive individual with a strong interest in laboratory-based research and development. They should be eager to learn new methods and technologies and possess excellent collaboration and communication skills.

What we offer

At the Blood Service, you will become part of a unique chain of help with voluntary donors and healthcare staff. We offer you an interesting and meaningful task as part of a motivated and professional team. Comprehensive orientation and support from your supervisor and team will help you get started in your work and develop in your own role. The well-being of our employees is particularly important to us: we invest in the well-being of our personnel e.g. by offering a wide range of sports and well-being benefits (see the list of benefits below). Read more about Blood Service as a workplace [here.](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/work-with-us/)

The position has a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension subject to project funding.

The salary for this position is determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Terveyspalveluala. The position is classified in Salary Grade 4, with a base salary of EUR 2847,83 per month for a full-time employee. In addition to the base salary, remuneration includes a personal salary component, which incorporates a length-of-service guarantee.

In this position, lentiviruses are handled, which might cause a health risk to an HIV-positive person. Therefore, this position is not suitable for an HIV-positive person, and the selected individual must regularly present an acceptable statement from occupational health services regarding their medical fitness.

How to apply and inquiries

In your application, please detail your experimental skills in cell culture, immunology, molecular biology, GLP/GMP-work, and gene editing, the duration of your experience with these techniques, and your motivation for research, development and lab work. Include preferably two possible references.

For more information on the position, please contact iCell group leader Helka Göös (helka.goos@bloodservice.fi).
Please submit your application through our electronic recruitment system. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.


Benefits


- Culture, sports, well-being and commuting benefits (Epassi)

- Extended occupational health care

- Lunch benefit

- Commuting exercise incentive

- Long vacations

- Employee sports benefits



Finnish Red Cross Blood Service

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service provides hospitals with safe and effective blood products and laboratory services that are essential for patient care. We also maintain the Stem Cell Registry and the Blood Service Biobank.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a non-profit organization. Our annual budget is approximately EUR 60 million, and we employ around 500 people.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service conducts active scientific research to advance biomedical knowledge in our areas of expertise. Read more about our Research Strategy [here](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/research/research-strategy/).

Email: hr@veripalvelu.fi Location: Haartmaninkatu 8

title: Scientist – Drug-Drug Interactions
description:
We are hiring a **Scientist, Drug-Drug Interactions** for a one-year fixed-term position, with experience in several of the following: designing/planning of assays, cell culturing (2D/3D), cell-based assays (FL/Lum/other endpoints), qPCR, enzyme kinetics and/or in vitro drug-drug interaction -related methodologies. We also expect good written and oral communication skills since the position requires working closely with other team members.

In this position, you will be responsible for part of the preclinical DDI, permeation and (in vitro) toxicity studies we perform for our customers. You will provide guidance and support to laboratory technicians and collaborate with other scientists in the team. You will process and analyze the results and prepare reports together with the senior scientist within each project.

You have a university degree MSc or PhD in a suitable field (e.g. pharmacy, biochemistry, cell biology, toxicology), with work experience relevant to the position. Experience in ADME/pharmacology as well as understanding of the methodologies employed in preclinical pharmacokinetic studies are considered as an advantage.

We offer an interesting, versatile and challenging position in a strongly growing company with a great atmosphere, and colleagues across our global organization. Furthermore, you will have an opportunity to be part of a continuously evolving drug development landscape. The position is available at our site in Oulu, Finland (on-site required).

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Vastuumyyjänä olet tärkeässä roolissa luomassa erinomaista asiakaskokemusta ja varmistamassa myymälän sujuvaa arkea.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat:

- Työntekijöiden ohjaaminen päivittäisessä työssä

- Itseohjautuvaa ja vastuullista työotetta

- Positiivista asennetta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Kykyä toimia osana tiimiä ja ohjata päivittäistä tekemistä

- Merkityksellisen työn osana Pelastusarmeijan auttamistyötä

**Tietoa Pelastusarmeijasta**

Pelastusarmeijan työn päämäärä on auttaa ihmistä kokonaisvaltaisesti. Työhön kuuluu mm. sosiaalinen apu, ruoka-apu, aikuisten harrastustoiminta, lasten ja nuorten kerhot, leirit, pyhäkoulu sekä hengelliset tilaisuudet. title: Purchaser
description:
Are you motivated by keeping materials moving, solving supply challenges and working closely with suppliers?

In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring material availability and reliable supply chain execution across Tanas operations.



Your responsibilities:

As a Purchaser, you are responsible for day-to-day operational purchasing. You ensure that materials and components are ordered, confirmed and delivered according to business needs, supplier agreements and production requirements.

You create, maintain and follow up purchase orders based on material demand, purchase requisitions, stock requirements and agreed supplier terms. You actively monitor supplier confirmations, delivery schedules and open orders, and work proactively to secure timely deliveries.

You also maintain accurate purchasing information in our ERP system and support the resolution of discrepancies between invoices, receipts and purchase orders.

You communicate regularly with suppliers to follow order status, delivery schedules, shortages, and possible changes. When needed, you coordinate corrective actions, identify delivery risks and escalate critical shortages, delays or supplier performance issues to the relevant stakeholders.

You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in operations, production, logistics, finance and other relevant functions, as well as with external suppliers. Through your work, you help ensure that information flows smoothly and operations can run reliably across the organization.



What we expect from you:

We are looking for someone with relevant education in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, engineering or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in purchasing, supply chain coordination, logistics, production planning or a similar operational role. You understand order-to-delivery processes and have basic commercial knowledge of prices, lead times and delivery terms.

Experience in ERP systems is required, and previous experience with NetSuite is considered a strong advantage. Experience in heavy machinery, industrial equipment, manufacturing or a similar operational environment is strongly preferred.

You work systematically and accurately, but you are also able to react quickly and prioritize when urgent material needs or delivery challenges arise. You communicate confidently with suppliers, take ownership of open issues and approach problems with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

Success in this role also requires strong cooperation skills and the ability to work effectively with different functions and stakeholders. Fluency in written and spoken Finnish and English is required.



What we offer:

You will join a professional and collaborative Operations team where your work has a direct impact on material availability, operational continuity and the reliability of our global supply chain.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your purchasing and supply chain expertise in an international technology company. You will work with a broad supplier network and collaborate across functions, giving you a comprehensive view of Tanas operations and supply chain.

Our working culture is down-to-earth and pragmatic, with a strong focus on openness, cooperation and getting things done together. At Tana, you will contribute to solutions that improve efficiency in waste management and support a more sustainable future.

If you are ready to take on an important role in operational purchasing and help us build a reliable, responsive supply chain, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Preferably Jyväskylä, other locations negotiable.



For more information, please contact Henrik Häggblom, VP Services & Operations, tel. +358 40 75 19027, during the following times:

Friday 11th September 12:00-13:00, Monday 14th September 12:00-13:00 or Tuesday 22nd September 13:00-14:00.



Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 27 September 2026. Please note that interviews may be conducted during the application period as suitable candidates are identified.




Tana Oy

TANA From Waste to Value®

Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. We not only produce the best fit-for-purpose machines designed to reduce the environmental impact of waste, but also provide tailored life cycle services, supported by a strong local presence and expertise. Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Nowadays TANA machines are exported to more than 50 countries.

description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Hotellet kan från sensommaren 2026 även stoltsera med sitt egna bryggeri.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 25 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en pigg och glad kollega till vår restaurang och bar.

Vi söker dig som brinner för öl och utöver servering i bar, restaurang och konferens även kan bistå vår bryggtekniker vid ölprovningar. Tids nog ser vi gärna att du även kan hålla egna provningar. Hos oss arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat, drinkar och inom kort även öl från vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som är noggrann och tycker om att ge gästen det lilla extra. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- Servera

- Duka av och på

- Kassahantering

- Blanda drinkar

- Bistå vid och även hålla ölprovningar

- Övrigt förekommande serveringsuppgifter


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Som person är du positiv, ansvarstagande, stresstålig, har lätt för att samarbeta, och har förståelse för att alla arbetskamrater är värdefulla. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med servering. Du behöver kunna svenska och engelska. Finska är mycket meriterande. Du behöver vara minst 20 år gammal samt ha alkopass/serveringspass.

**Varaktighet**

Tjänsten är på hel- eller deltid hos oss på Park Restaurang & Bar. Serveringsjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med kvällspass under veckans alla dagar. Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.

**Lön**

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com ! Sista ansökningsdag är den 30.9.2026 men intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och platsen kan bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kontakta Lizette på tel. 018-14130.

title: SprinDrive: Manufacturing Engineer (Electromechanics)
description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Laserkatu 6, 53850 Lappeenranta, Finland

**Application deadline:** 24.9.2026

Want to bridge the gap between engineering and manufacturing in cutting-edge magnetic bearing technology?

**What will you be doing?**

SpinDrive is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join its R&D team in Lappeenranta. In this role, youll support the development and production of Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components by combining practical assembly work with manufacturing development, workstation setup, documentation, and supplier coordination. You will report to SpinDrives Lead Mechanical Engineer and collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, suppliers, and supply chain stakeholders.

A key part of the role is to help establish and organize SpinDrives own practical test assembly and test winding capabilities. As SpinDrive develops its in-house workshop, you will help define the workspace, identify and source suitable tools, equipment, measuring instruments, consumables, insulation materials, and other workshop requirements as well as establish practical ways of working. You will use your industrial experience and knowledge of local suppliers and subcontractors to help us build an efficient and well-organized manufacturing environment.

The role includes hands-on coil winding and related electrical assembly, but it is broader than winding alone. We are looking for a practical manufacturing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day assembly test activities, organize the workstation and tooling, and support engineers during prototype builds. Serial production is later outsourced to SpinDrive international subcontractors, and you will help to support technical discussions with them.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will test, manufacture, and improve precision coil winding solutions for Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components while supporting prototype production and assembly activities. You will perform test coil winding, preparation, soldering, insulation, impregnation, and related assembly processes, while helping establish and organize the required workspace, tooling, equipment, materials, and workflows.

Working closely with the engineering team, you will develop practical fixtures, tooling, work instructions, and assembly methods, interpret technical documentation, and provide feedback on manufacturability. You will establish appropriate quality, testing, documentation, and traceability practices and collaborate with local suppliers and subcontractors to source equipment, materials, tooling, and manufacturing services. You will also support technical discussions with SpinDrive international subcontractors for volume manufacturing.

**What kind of person thrives in this role and why?**

You might be the person we are looking for if you enjoy hands-on technical work and taking responsibility for making a workshop and manufacturing process work in practice. You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes, tooling, and workspaces are still being developed, and you enjoy finding practical solutions rather than waiting for predefined procedures.

We especially value practical manufacturing experience, good organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with engineers and suppliers. Experience with local Finnish manufacturing suppliers and subcontractors is particularly valuable, as the role will involve building the practical infrastructure around our in-house assembly activities.

**We hope you have:**

- At least 3 years of practical experience in industrial manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, electrical or mechanical production, or related hands-on work.

- Experience with electrical motors, coils, wires, electrical components, or similar industrial equipment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Experience organizing workspaces, production areas, tooling, equipment and materials.

- Experience sourcing or working with local suppliers, subcontractors, tools, equipment, or manufacturing services.

- Good communication skills and full working proficiency in English.

- Solution-oriented, self-driven, and well-organized working style.

- Willingness to perform hands-on work while also taking ownership of broader manufacturing and workshop-development activities.


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with precision coil winding, electric motor manufacturing, or electrical assembly.

- Experience developing or improving tooling, fixtures, insulation, winding, or assembly methods.

- Established knowledge of Finnish/local suppliers for industrial tools, equipment, materials, machining, fabrication or specialist manufacturing services.

- Experience with prototype manufacturing and low-volume production.

- Experience in international manufacturing environments.

- Experience with CAD tools or the ability to work effectively with CAD-based technical documentation.


**What SpinDrive offers you:**

- Work closely with experienced engineers developing next-generation magnetic bearing technology for industrial applications

- Shape practical manufacturing solutions where your hands-on expertise has a direct impact on product quality

- Grow your technical skills in an international team collaborating across engineering, R&D, and supplier networks

- Travel internationally and build relationships with manufacturing partners across Europe

- Join a scaling technology company where you can contribute beyond a narrow role definition

- The compensation will include the salary and stock options to share the benefits of SpinDrives growth.


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by SpinDrive Oy. The role is based mainly onsite in Lappeenranta, Finland, and includes some travel to supplier locations. We hope you can work mainly from the office, with the possibility for occasional remote workdays. The onboarding period will take place primarily in Lappeenranta and is expected to last approximately 2–3 months. The start date is as soon as possible, but the latest in November 2026.

title: Postdoctoral researcher in synthesis and analysis
description:
The University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en), founded in 1640, is one of the worlds leading universities for multidisciplinary research. The university has an international academic community of 40,000 students and staff members. The Department of Chemistry (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science/faculty/chemistry) at the Faculty of Science (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science) carries out research on chemistry and its applications at an international level and provides academic teaching based on high quality research.
The Department of Chemistry invites applications for one
POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER
position in Synthesis and Analysis. The successful applicant will join the developing research group at the Department of Chemistry. The position is fixed-term for 12 months with a possible extension. Employment starts as soon as possible.

Position description
The postdoctoral position funded by the Research Council of Finland aims to design closed-loop dissolution/activation laboratory and scaled-up methodologies for recycling platinum group metals and rare-earth elements using green chemicals energy- and resource-efficient approaches - including organometallurgy and mechanochemistry - complying with sustainable development, resource safety and circular economy. This interdisciplinary project lays on the interface between coordination chemistry, metal dissolution and organometallurgy, organic chemistry, methodology development and mechanochemistry. Postdoctoral researchers tasks will include the development of recycling protocols for different metals, advanced characterization of the reaction mixtures and obtained isolated materials. The work will also comprise help in the supervision of undergraduate, graduate and visiting students. The researcher is expected to present their findings in scientific meetings, prepare funding applications for travel and research grants, as well as prepare manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. The position has a trial period of 6 months.

Requirements
Motivated, ambitious and self-driven candidates with a PhD degree in a relevant field (chemistry or related) interested in metal recycling are encouraged to apply. Experience in the fields of coordination complex chemistry, molecular metal compounds, homogeneous metal catalysis, organic synthesis, mechanochemistry of metals, as well as experience in analytical techniques including NMR, PXRD, HRMS and ICP-MS/AES are advantageous. Most importantly, you should have strong motivation for research in a highly multidisciplinary topic, enthusiasm to learn new things and contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research team. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. We will offer a meaningful, original and ambitious scientific project in an international, top-level research environment. From the applicant we expect high motivation to conduct demanding experimental work, as well as a curiosity driven science-enthusiastic mindset.

Salary and benefits
The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (requirement level 5). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* a CV with a list of publications,
* a brief description of your research interests (1 page) with clear indication on the motivation to apply for this position,
* a copy of a PhD degree certificate.

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts. Applications generated by AI do not meet our expectations.
The deadline for applications is October 8th, unless the right candidate is found before. Interviews will commence right away, already during the application period.

Additional information
For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Research Council of Finland Fellow, Dr. Anže Zupanc (anze.zupanc@helsinki.fi). For more information on Dr. Zupancs publications, see Anže Zupanc (0000-0002-3697-7839) - ORCID and Anže Zupanc - Google Scholar.

title: Power Electronics Simulation Engineer, Tampere
description:
About the role

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power electronics and electrical grid technology. You will join a niche team of experts where your work directly impacts how high-voltage grids operate globally.

In this position, you will be part of the NPI (New Product Introduction) team, focusing on the simulation and validation of advanced grid solutions. Your main tool will be the RTDS (Real-Time Digital Simulator), and your daily work involves Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations. Because the role requires hands-on management of RTDS hardware and laboratory equipment, this position is fully office/lab-based in Tampere.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities include:
- Running and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations.
- Managing and developing RTDS hardware setups.
- Using Matlab & Simulink for simulation and building test benches.
- Analyzing fault situations and system performance in a high-voltage grid context.
- Collaborating closely with design engineers to validate control systems.

You are offered...
- Long-term Mentorship: A thorough and supportive onboarding process into a niche technology area.
- International Opportunities: While the base role is in Tampere, there is a possibility for global site assignments (1–2 years down the line) for those interested in international travel.
- Cutting-edge Tech: Access to the latest simulation hardware and the chance to work on large-scale grid projects.

We are looking for

We value potential and learning agility above all else. This is a highly specialized field, and we are prepared to provide long-term onboarding for the right person. Whether you are a recent graduate with a strong academic background or a professional looking to pivot into grid technology, your ability to grasp complex systems is what matters.

Requirements:
- Technical Education: A University degree (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.
- Control Theory: A deep understanding of the interface between power electronics and the electrical grid (control side expertise is critical).
- Software Tools: Proficiency in Matlab & Simulink.
- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly in English (our primary working language).
- Location: Readiness to work onsite in Tampere (no remote work option due to hardware requirements).

We appreciate if you'll have...
- Previous experience with RTDS, HIL testing, or high-voltage laboratories.
- Familiarity with the power electronics industry

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Open Application: Domestic Helper Opportunity in the Capital region
description:
OPEN APPLICATION: DOMESTIC HELPER / HOUSEKEEPER – HELSINKI, ESPOO & VANTAA

Are you looking for meaningful work where you can support families in their everyday lives?

Curon Helpperi is continuously looking for experienced Domestic Helpers to join our friendly and supportive team in the Capital Region. This is an open application, which means that we may not have a suitable position available immediately. We review applications as our staffing needs change and new work opportunities become available.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Domestic Helper, you provide practical day-to-day support that helps households run smoothly and makes everyday life easier for families.

The work is varied, and your tasks depend on each clients individual needs. Your working week could include cooking, cleaning, laundry care, organizing, ironing, childcare support, or helping seniors with their everyday routines.

Your tasks may include:

* Cleaning and maintaining clients homes

* Meal planning and cooking

* Laundry care, ironing and folding clothes

* Childcare and/or support for seniors

* Light gardening and outdoor tasks

* Pet care, such as walking a dog


WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION

* Work is mainly available from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:30

* Occasional evening or weekend work may also be available

* The work takes place in several client homes across the Capital Region

* Most clients are located in Helsinki and Espoo, but work may also be available in Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas


WE OFFER

* Opportunities for gig work, part-time work or full-time employment, depending on our current staffing needs and your availability

* A supportive working environment and a caring team

* Training, guidance and support in your work

* An ongoing employment contract when applicable

* Salary according to the Facility Services Collective Agreement

For example, the salary for a full-time position with 100% working hours is €2,074 per month. The hourly salary is €13 per hour.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* At least two years of experience as a domestic helper or housekeeper, or at least two years of cleaning experience combined with strong cooking skills

* Ability to prepare both Western dishes and food from other cuisines

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Fluent English or Finnish — you must be able to communicate well in at least one of these languages

* You are already living in Finland and have the right to work in Finland

* A positive attitude, reliability and respect for clients privacy

A valid driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage but are not required.


APPLICATION PROCESS

If this type of work feels right for you, please submit an open application through the link below.

Please note that this is an ongoing open application, and we may not have a suitable position available immediately. Applications are accepted only through the application form. We will contact suitable candidates when work opportunities become available.

Thank you for your interest in working with Curon Helpperi. We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas
Start date: According to our staffing needs and the candidates availability
Application period: Ongoing
