People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Senior Manager, EMEA Service Delivery Lead (f/m/d)  is a regional leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across all EMEA sites, serving Siemens software engineers across Europe, Middle East, and Africa. The Senior Manager directly leads EMEA SD Managers and is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, and execution of global GES programmes within the EMEA region.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional Leadership & Operations

- Lead and develop a regional team of SD Managers responsible for engineering support across EMEA sites.- Own regional SLO/SLA performance; ensure targets are met, tracked, and reported consistently.- Drive operational consistency across EMEA sites aligned to global GES standards and Global Operations Excellence (GOE) defined processes.- Act as the primary escalation point for EMEA service issues, customer concerns, and critical incidents.- Ensure CMDB accuracy, asset management, and monitoring compliance across EMEA sites.

Programme Delivery

- Lead EMEA execution of global transformation programmes.- Maintain regional project status, risks, and blockers; provide regular updates to the Global SD Director.- Coordinate with different stakeholders on regional deployments and platform changes.

People Leadership

- Line-manage EMEA SD Managers; set clear objectives, conduct performance reviews, and support career development.- Foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture across geographically dispersed EMEA teams.- Identify talent gaps, succession risks, and training needs within the EMEA SD function.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build strong relationships with EMEA sites stakeholders, business units, and functional managers.- Represent the EMEA region in GES global leadership forums, cross-functional reviews, and planning cycles.- Collaborate with Americas and APAC SD Leads to share best practices and drive global consistency.

Engineering Segment Engagement

- Execute the GES engineering segment engagement model within EMEA; act as the regional point of contact for EMEA segment leads on infrastructure quality, environment needs, and development productivity.- Establish a structured engagement cadence with EMEA engineering segment representatives to gather feedback on CI/CD environments, tooling gaps, and productivity blockers.- Identify and escalate EMEA-specific development environment constraints that impact engineering velocity; collaborate with GOE and Architecture & Standards to drive resolution.- Contribute regional segment insights to GES-wide reporting on developer productivity and service quality.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Substantial relevant experience in service delivery, infrastructure operations, or engineering support, with a demonstrated track record of regional management responsibility across multiple countries.- Proven experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple countries within the EMEA region.- Strong working knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and service level management practices.- Experience managing escalations, service performance, and operational governance in a complex enterprise environment.- Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional programmes and change within large, matrixed organizations.- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; fluent in English (additional language proficiency is an advantage).- Solid understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle tracking, and software asset inventory across distributed sites.- Practical knowledge of data center operations, including RDC/colocation environments, physical infrastructure management, and capacity oversight.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup frameworks sufficient to manage and govern SD teams responsible for these environments.- Awareness of vulnerability management practices, including coordination with security teams on remediation tracking and compliance obligations across EMEA sites.- Familiarity with software development practices and the SDLC; ability to engage with engineering teams on environment needs and tooling requirements without deep hands-on development experience.- Awareness of CI/CD concepts and pipeline dependencies; sufficient understanding to identify where GES infrastructure is a bottleneck or enabler for engineering delivery.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering or large-scale enterprise infrastructure environments.- Hands-on or supervisory experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack or equivalent platforms).- Exposure to high-performance or grid computing environments — understanding of compute cluster operations, job scheduling, and distributed infrastructure management.- Understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery across EMEA.- Experience managing EMEA-specific regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., data residency, works council processes, GDPR implications for IT operations).- Exposure to software engineering or DevOps environments — direct collaboration with development teams or platform engineering; comfort discussing developer workflow tooling, build pipelines, and environment provisioning.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required at minimum; Managing Professional track highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation — IT governance and control framework awareness.- ISO 27001 awareness — relevant to EMEA regulatory and security compliance considerations.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Foundation or Practitioner.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This role is based in EMEA, with a preference for one of Siemens' DISW established locations.
Regular travel across EMEA sites is expected.

Part of: GES Global Service Delivery function, GTI

description: Per Cliente leader nel suo settore di riferimento, siamo alla ricerca di un* RESPONSABILE LOGISTICA. La risorsa, riportando alla Direzione, dovrà: Coordinare un gruppo di circa 10 persone fornendo supporto e supervisione per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Collaborare con altri dipartimenti, come Produzione e Pianificazione, per coordinare la consegna dei materiali ai reparti di produzione e di assemblaggio. Gestire e supervisionare tutte le operazioni logistiche, garantendo l'efficienza e l'accuratezza delle attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e trasferimento dei materiali. Assicurare il corretto ricevimento dei materiali in entrata, effettuando controlli di corrispondenza merce e quantità, garantendo l'integrità delle merci durante il processo di immagazzinamento. Ottimizzare i flussi di trasferimento dei materiali tra i due siti produttivi, definendo le opportune regole di gestione che possano correttamente bilanciare le esigenze di disponibilità dei materiali nelle aree produttive con la frequenza dei navettaggi. Supervisionare la gestione degli inventari, eseguendo controlli regolari per garantire l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvere eventuali discrepanze o errori. Utilizzare software avanzati per la gestione del magazzino, come i magazzini verticali, al fine di migliorare l'efficienza e l'automazione delle operazioni. Raccogliere e analizzare in modo strutturato con l'ausilio delle metodologie e degli strumenti più avanzati i dati relativi ai flussi fisici nelle diverse aree aziendali (accettazione, stoccaggio, reparti e bordo linee) al fine di proporre azioni di ottimizzazione volte all'eliminazione di eventuali attività a non valore aggiunto e alla riduzione di eventuali sprechi. Mappare e analizzare i flussi informativi a livello di sistema gestionale (ERP) e sistemi dipartimentali (WMS/magazzini automatici) con l'obiettivo di individuare possibili miglioramenti che rendano più completi e veloci i trasferimenti delle informazioni. Monitorare e garantire il rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza e sulle pratiche di lavoro corrette nel magazzino. Gestire la manutenzione delle attrezzature e degli impianti del magazzino, compresi magazzini verticali e muletti. Coordinare le attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, garantendo che le attrezzature siano in buone condizioni e che siano effettuate eventuali riparazioni o sostituzioni necessarie. REQUISITI Esperienza pregressa nella gestione di magazzini in realtà strutturate (meglio se operanti su commessa), preferibilmente caratterizzate dalla presenza di sistemi automatizzati (come magazzini verticali) e dall'utilizzo di software dipartimentali (tipo WMS - Warehouse Management Systems). Ottima capacità organizzativa per pianificare le attività logistiche e coordinare le risorse che a lui rispondono. Conoscenza delle best practice nella gestione del magazzino, inclusi processi di stoccaggio e movimentazione dei materiali. Leadership comprovata, con esperienza nella gestione di un team e nella delega di compiti. Capacità di analisi e problem-solving per identificare inefficienze, implementare soluzioni e migliorare i processi operativi. Familiarità con gli strumenti informatici utilizzati per l'analisi dei dati e capacità di elaborazione di report. Ottime competenze comunicative e capacità di collaborare con altri dipartimenti per garantire una gestione integrata delle operazioni. Familiarità con le normative sulla sicurezza e la salute sul lavoro relative alle attività di magazzino. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

- Experience with CFD or multiphysics simulations

- Experience developing simulation methods, processes, or analysis tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Solve varied structural analysis challenges, from focused simulations to complex investigations requiring deeper technical analysis.

- Shape simulation methods and ways of working, giving you opportunities to influence how structural analysis is developed and applied.

- Apply your expertise to engineering decisions that directly support the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies.

- Collaborate across an international R&D environment where experienced specialists actively share methods, findings, and technical knowledge.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381516/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

Opererà come punto di raccordo tra reparti interni e fornitori it esterni, garantendo efficienza e qualità dei servizi. Sarà il riferimento IT aziendale, fornendo supporto tecnico di primo livello agli utenti e guidandoli nell'evoluzione dei processi interni, contribuendo all'introduzione di nuove strategie e al miglioramento continuo delle attività quotidiane. Il tutto in un contesto lavorativo caratterizzato da un ambiente familiare e collaborativo, dove le persone lavorano con spirito proattivo, forte senso di squadra e voglia di crescere insieme. Un contesto dinamico e in evoluzione, che offre la possibilità di avere un impatto concreto sui processi e sullo sviluppo aziendale. title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Delivery Manager - Riga, Latvia
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Delivery Manager, you will ensure smooth execution of technical deliveries by maintaining structure across tasks, builds, and milestones, while acting as a key coordination point between engineering, QA, and stakeholders. This is a hands-on role combining delivery coordination, build and deployment execution, and technical troubleshooting. You will work closely with teams to ensure builds are consistently delivered, tested, and available for review, while keeping communication clear and expectations aligned across all parties.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Delivery & Coordination

    Maintain structure and visibility across ongoing deliverables, tasks, and milestones.
    Track ownership and deadlines, follow up on progress, and ensure timely execution.
    Participate in internal and external meetings to capture requirements, decisions, and action items.
    Document outcomes of discussions to ensure clarity and continuity for the team.
    Maintain clear visibility of delivery status, dependencies, and potential risks.
    Support prioritization and coordination across teams without direct managerial authority.

Technical Execution

Work with existing tools and pipelines to:

    Create and manage builds.
    Deploy builds to target environments or devices.
    Prepare builds for internal testing and stakeholder review.
    Perform sanity checks, smoke testing, and basic validation of builds.
    Distribute deliverables to stakeholders and collect feedback.
    Troubleshoot build, deployment, or environment-related issues where possible.
    Act as a practical technical support layer for delivery and release activities.

Communication & Stakeholder Support

    Serve as a point of contact for delivery updates and build availability.
    Translate technical progress into clear, structured, and actionable updates.
    Ensure alignment of expectations between technical teams and stakeholders.
    Support transparent and consistent communication across all involved parties.

WHAT WE ASK OF YOU

    Strong hands-on technical background (software, tools, or build systems relevant to the team).
    Experience with build systems, deployment workflows, or CI/CD pipelines.
    Ability to set up, run, and test builds independently.
    Comfortable working with existing tools and adapting to new ones quickly.
    Solid troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
    Professional proficient in spoken and written English (knowledge of English is required, as the company is international and it is necessary to communicate in English with foreign colleagues daily).
    Excellent organization and task-tracking abilities.
    Strong written and verbal communication skills.
    Comfortable working across disciplines (engineering, QA, stakeholders).
    High attention to detail and follow-through.
    Proactive, self-driven, and reliable.

NICE TO HAVE

    Experience in game development, software delivery, or technical production roles.
    Familiarity with Agile or iterative development workflows.
    Previous experience acting as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.
    Basic scripting or automation experience.

WHAT WE OFFER IN EXCHANGE

    Monthly salary from 3700 EUR to 5500 EUR gross/per month.
    Health insurance from the first day of employment.
    Paid parking next to the office as required.
    On-site work model: 5 days from the office.
    Opportunities for both professional growth and personal development.
    Taking part in creating studios as part of an award-winning iGaming business.
    Truly international experience and collaboration possibilities with impactful results.

title: BIM Technician - Riga, Latvia

To achieve this, we bet on ourselves. We know that success is a collective effort, and our team is driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared commitment to grow and succeed — while embracing every step of the journey.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will work across all design stages, from concept to delivery, supporting both local and international projects.

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d) f. Liechtenstein gesucht A26/9821 Li (Hausdame/Housekeeper)
description:
Liechtenstein

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks
- Aufmerksame Betreuung der Hausherren sowie professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Gästen
- Unterstützung bei Empfängen, Einladungen und besonderen Anlässen
- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Pflege hochwertiger Wäsche und Textilien
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Antiquitäten, Kunstobjekten und anspruchsvoller Einrichtung
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

Supporter, concevoir et faire émerger de nouveaux services autour de ses domaines de compétence (cloud public, cloud native, architecture, automatisation, plateforme), en participant à la définition des standards, des briques techniques, de la documentation et du positionnement de ces services dans le catalogue de l'entreprise. Maîtriser les concepts et architectures IaaS, PaaS, KaaS, cloud public, cloud souverain et services managés. Avoir une connaissance d'OVH Public Cloud et/ou de Clever Cloud. Maîtriser les principes d'architecture cloud native et les plateformes conteneurisées, en particulier Kubernetes et l'écosystème associé. Connaître plusieurs technologies cloud native et DevOps parmi les suivant/antes : GitLab, Keycloak, Nexus, SonarQube, FluxCD, Crossplane, Velero, Kasten, RabbitMQ, Kafka, OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, AKS, EKS ou équivalents. Être capable d'intégrer les exigences de sécurité, de conformité, de gouvernance et d'exploitabilité dans les choix d'architecture. Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

L'allemand est aussi un atout.Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance de la législation sociale et du droit du travail luxembourgeois, ainsi que des obligations administratives et déclaratives liées à la gestion des salaires.Vous recherchez une structure stable et à taille humaine, où la proximité, la qualité des prestations et le bien-être des collaborateurs constituent de véritables priorités. Offre & avantages / Fiduciaire - Payroll - Luxembourg Vous bénéficierez d'une rémunération attractive pouvant atteindre 7. € brut par mois, déterminée en fonction de votre expérience, de votre expertise et de votre niveau d'autonomie.Votre package salarial sera complété par un bonus annuel, des chèques-repas, un plan de pension ainsi qu'une place de parking, vous permettant de bénéficier d'un ensemble d'avantages particulier/ièrement compétitif.Vous rejoindrez une fiduciaire stable à taille humaine, reconnue pour la qualité de son environnement de travail, la proximité de son management et la fidélité de ses collaborateurs.Vous profiterez d'une grande flexibilité dans l'organisation de votre temps de travail. description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)

- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)

- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

Définir les audiences, objectifs de campagne et parcours de conversion adaptés. Analyser les performances et transformer les données en actions concrètes. Identifier les audiences, campagnes et créations générant les meilleurs résultats. Concevoir des reportings clairs orientés performance, conversions et ROI. Fournir des recommandations concrètes et priorisées pour chaque client. Assurer une veille régulier/ière sur les évolutions de Meta Ads et les nouvelles fonctionnalités de la plateforme. Profil recherché Expérience : expérience solide et démontrable dans la gestion et l'optimisation de campagnes Meta Ads, idéalement sur plusieurs secteurs d'activité. Meta Ads : excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads Manager et de la gestion de campagnes Facebook et Instagram. Acquisition : bonne compréhension des stratégies de génération de leads, conversion et retargeting. Tracking : bonne maîtrise du Meta Pixel, des événements de conversion et bonne compréhension de la Conversions API. Analytics : bonne connaissance de Google Analytics 4 et Google Tag Manager. Créatives : capacité à analyser les performances des créations et à formuler des recommandations sur les angles, messages, formats et contenus à tester. Performance : approche fortement orientée ROI et rentabilité, au-delà des simples métriques de visibilité ou d'engagement. Analyse : capacité à interpréter les données et à transformer rapidement les résultats en actions d'optimisation concrètes. Organisation : excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs comptes et projets simultanément et à travailler de manier/ière autonome. Qualités : autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et capacité à formuler des recommandations. title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

Marketing support and execution:

Required Qualifications:

• Knowledge of customer lifecycle management processes, tools and compliance tracking.
• Ability to work in fast-paced, dynamic environments, managing multiple priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French; additional European languages are a plus.

• Be a key enabler in the digital transformation journey of businesses and researchers, leveraging supercomputing and AI.
• Work in a high-tech environment with exposure to cutting-edge computing solutions.
• Collaborate with a diverse team of industry experts in HPC, AI, and cloud computing.
• Opportunity to contribute to streamlining sales operations and enhancing customer experience in a growing tech-driven organization.

title: Project Manager (m/f)
description:
Your mission

As a Project Manager, you will lead selected cross-functional projects from initiation through to successful delivery.

Working closely with teams across R&D, Production, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, IT and other key functions, you will ensure that projects are delivered in line with their technical, quality, cost and timing objectives.

Your role will be to provide structure, coordination and leadership throughout the project lifecycle while anticipating risks, solving complex issues and ensuring effective communication between all stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities

Project planning and organization

You will be responsible for structuring and organizing projects to ensure clear objectives and efficient execution:

    Set up and maintain project structures, including project timelines, team organization, budgets and resource planning

    Develop detailed project plans covering milestones, work plans, critical paths, risk management, cost and benefit analysis, staffing requirements and budgets

    Define, agree on and cascade project objectives to all relevant stakeholders

    Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure that everyone works towards common objectives

    Organize project meetings and key review sessions, including technical reviews and launch readiness reviews

    Assign and coordinate the activities required from the different functions involved in the project

    Monitor project progress and follow up on the completion of actions to ensure the project is delivered on time


Project coordination and prioritization

In a dynamic environment where multiple requests and priorities may arise simultaneously, you will play a key role in ensuring that project resources are focused on the right activities:

    Analyze, filter and prioritize incoming requests based on project priorities, business needs and available resources

    Ensure that the prioritization of customer requests is aligned and agreed upon with the Sales team

    Manage competing priorities and support teams in maintaining focus on the most critical activities

    Coordinate the different departments involved in the project, including Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, IT and Sales

    Ensure alignment between project requirements, operational capabilities and available resources


Project performance and risk management

You will actively monitor project performance and identify potential risks before they impact project delivery:

    Systematically identify, assess and manage technical, financial, operational and project-related risks

    Develop and coordinate appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

    Monitor project performance against customer and internal targets

    Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, development budgets, cost objectives and project milestones

    Manage project cost calculations in collaboration with Purchasing, Production and Controlling

    Monitor project profitability and contribute to the achievement of internal financial objectives

    Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team whenever possible

    Escalate critical issues to management when they cannot be resolved within the project team

    Make informed decisions based on technical, financial, quality and timing considerations


Customer and supplier coordination

You will contribute to ensuring efficient coordination with external stakeholders while working closely with the relevant internal teams:

    Support customer communication regarding project timing, project status, changes and key milestones

    Coordinate customer-related actions in close collaboration with the Sales department

    Help ensure that customer expectations and requirements are clearly communicated internally

    Support the preparation of customer communications using the appropriate language and format

    Coordinate supplier-related activities and support communication with suppliers in collaboration with the Purchasing department

    Follow up on supplier-related actions that may impact project timing, cost, quality or technical requirements


Communication, reporting and documentation

Clear and reliable communication will be essential to the successful delivery of your projects:

    Communicate project objectives, priorities and progress to the project team and management

    Prepare and contribute to project reviews, progress reports and management updates

    Ensure that project documentation is complete, accurate and regularly updated

    Maintain project plans, action lists, risk assessments, meeting minutes and other key project records

    Record and distribute meeting minutes and ensure appropriate follow-up of agreed actions

    Use and maintain project management databases and centralized information systems to ensure reliable and consistent information

    Encourage the use of common project management tools and processes to maintain a single and reliable source of information

    Provide timely feedback on project team performance to the relevant functional managers when appropriate



Your profile

Education and technical background

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field

    A Master's degree would be considered an advantage

    Strong ability to understand, analyze and absorb technical information

    Knowledge of beverage systems would be a strong advantage

    Knowledge of valves and pressure regulators would also be highly appreciated


Professional experience

    At least 5 years of experience in project or program management

    Previous experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment

    Experience in sectors such as Medical, Automotive or Food & Beverage would be considered an advantage

    Proven experience managing complex and cross-functional projects

    Solid understanding of project management methodologies, tools and techniques

    Experience managing project budgets, costs and financial aspects would be an advantage


Technical and project management skills

    Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling and resource management

    Ability to develop and manage project timelines, milestones and critical paths

    Experience with risk management and problem-solving methodologies

    Ability to monitor project budgets, costs and profitability

    Strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and demanding environment

    Ability to filter and prioritize requests based on project and business priorities

    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and MS Project

    Knowledge of financial management would be an advantage


Languages

    Fluent in English, both written and spoken

    French and/or German would be considered strong assets


Your professional strengths

    Strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate and engage cross-functional teams

    Excellent organizational and prioritization skills

    Ability to work independently while remaining aligned with project objectives

    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

    Comfortable making decisions based on technical, financial, timing and quality considerations

    Ability to manage conflicts constructively and bring stakeholders towards common objectives

    Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
