title: Consultant Senior - Accountant  (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:
The Senior accountant will have the following responsibilities:

-Take ownership of selected legal entities, balance-sheet areas or accounting workstreams.
-Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments and account reconciliations.
-Ensure transactions are recorded accurately, completely and in the appropriate accounting period.
-Investigate unexpected movements and resolve accounting discrepancies.
-Prepare variance analyses and explanations of material balance movements.
-Support and improve monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities.
-Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Group Accounting and local accounting providers.
-Analyse and account for complex, unusual or previously unresolved transactions.
-Prepare accounting position papers or technical memoranda when required.
-Support intercompany accounting, reconciliations and mismatch resolution.
-Investigate cash, bank-fee, foreign-exchange and transaction-flow discrepancies.
-Review historical balances and identify unsupported, unreconciled, duplicated or incorrectly classified items.
-Reconcile and remediate accounting data in SAP.
-Establish reliable opening balances and clear audit trails.
-Correct recurring posting, mapping and master-data issues.
-Help reinforce SAP as the primary accounting source of truth.
-Reconcile differences between the client's records and those maintained by local accounting providers.
-Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting evidence and accounting explanations.
-Respond directly and independently to external-auditor requests.
-Support statutory audits for European legal entities.
-Prepare or contribute to balance-sheet substantiation, going-concern assessments and other accounting papers.
-Maintain organised, complete and review-ready documentation.
-Document accounting procedures and month-end activities.
-Create or improve standard operating procedures, checklists and control evidence.
-Perform root-cause analysis of recurring accounting issues.
-Recommend and implement sustainable process improvements.
-Contribute to the development of the accounting control matrix.
-Use SAP and Excel for accounting operations, reconciliations and data analysis.
-Work effectively with large datasets and incomplete or imperfect source information.
-Identify accounting activities that can be standardised, simplified or automated.
-Use tools such as Power Query, SQL, automation platforms or AI where they provide a practical benefit.
-Document material automated processes so that they can be understood and maintained by the team.
-Reduce recurring errors, unnecessary manual work and operational dependencies.

Contraintes:
Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

description:
Description de tâches:


Join our Audit Recruitment Days – 22 and 23 October 2026


Make your mark:

Forget the traditional job interview process. KPMG Luxembourg's Audit Recruitment Days are a two-day immersive experience  designed to give you a real feel for what it means to be an Auditor at KPMG. Through interactive challenges, innovative assessment activities you'll get the chance to explore how modern audit is evolving while also getting to know our people, our culture and life in Luxembourg, all while being considered for a career opportunity at KPMG Luxembourg..

Audit is evolving rapidly. Emerging technologies, data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming the profession, creating exciting opportunities for curious minds who combine strong business understanding with a passion for innovation.

Whether your background is in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering or Technology, the Recruitment Days will allow you to experience how modern Audit combines professional judgment, technology and collaboration to create trust.


What to expect:

Day 1 - Step into #TeamBlue: You'll start the day at our KPMG Luxembourg headquarters where you'll kick things off with interactive presentations about KPMG and the world of Audit. After lunch, you'll dive into the Audit Tech Challenge, a collaborative activity that gives you a real taste of modern Audit in action. In the afternoon, you'll get to discover Luxembourg through a fun team-based urban rally. The day will end with a special networking dinner with our Partners and Service Line Leaders before returning to your accommodation for the night, provided by KPMG.

Day 2 - Time to shine: This is where you'll show your strengths and take part in your a business interview with our Audit professionals. Following the interview, you'll get to participate in an engaging Virtual Reality Cchallenge, meet our people in a lively speed-networking session, and have an exclusive office tour. We'll wrap the day up with lunch followed by a closing session, where a few surprises and highlights await!

The following week, you'll receive feedback because we value transparency and growth! If the outcome is positive, you will also receive a job offer to join KPMG Luxembourg.


Your future role:

As a Junior Auditor, you'll do much more than just review financial information.

You'll combine audit expertise with technology, data and innovation to help clients build trust in an increasingly digital world. Your responsibilities will include:

Applying your accounting and finance knowledge to real client engagements using IFRS, Luxembourg GAAP and international auditing standards.  
Working alongside experienced auditors to understand business processes, identify risks and deliver high-quality audits.  
Leveraging data, technology and emerging AI-enabled tools to support audit procedures and improve efficiency.  
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges.  
Contributing to innovative projects that improve audit methodologies, data analytics and digital transformation.  
Continuously developing both your audit expertise and your digital capabilities throughout your career.


Who we're looking for:

We're looking for ambitious, sharp-minded people who are ready to grow and make an impact with us at KPMG Luxembourg. If you check these boxes, we want to hear from you! Here's what you need to know:

Start date: We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2027 and January 2028.
Education: You have (or will soon have) a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Audit, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science or IT. Bonus points if you're interested in professional accountancy qualifications (e.g., IRE).
Languages: You're fluent in English, plus either French, German, or Luxembourgish.
Mindset: Analytical, curious about technology, eager to learn, collaborative and ready to embrace innovation.  
Integrity: You value quality, ethics and doing the right thing.


What's in it for you:

Your future starts here! At KPMG, you'll get:

Training and support: A full-on learning experience, including our Induction Week plus all the resources to keep leveling up.  
Career growth: Want to work in another department or in a different office? We make it part of your professional development.
Impactful work: Work with top experts, collaborate with global clients, and use cutting-edge technology to make a difference.
Fun and community: From KPMG Plage to staff parties and sports activities, we make work-life balance a reality.
Flexibility: Work from home or at different office locations – we're all about that modern work setup.
Inclusive culture: We champion diversity, gender equality, and strong support for the LGBTQ+ community. You belong here!
This isn't just another job opportunity - it's your chance to join a dynamic, forward-thinking team that values your potential. Join #TeamBlue and be part of something bigger!

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist-Semantic AI, Central Reliability Maintenance Eng.
description:
Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist – Semantic AI, Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering
Job ID: 10517592 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon we believe that Every Day is still Day One! We're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and Amazon's Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (C-RME) team is at the heart of that mission, using science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally.
We are seeking a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist to lead key semantic layer and knowledge intelligence initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of knowledge engineering, ontology design, and applied AI, owning workstreams for the development of semantic foundations and dedicated science approaches that ensure their accuracy, consistency, and explainability in service of agentic and non-agentic AI across RME.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to the success of Central and Field RME teams working with new launches of Amazon buildings, as well as ensure that our Field teams benefit from state-of-the art AI solutions to support Global Operational Excellence.
You will closely work with our team of senior scientists and systems engineers in our knowledge intelligence team, which is leading the full lifecycle of graph-based AI solutions, from customer problem formulation and ontology design to production deployment, enabling network-wide data discovery, decision support, and compliance monitoring.
A core part of your mandate is to lead the semantic modelling and ontological foundation layer that supports both explainability and retrieval capabilities. This foundation feeds into transversal initiatives spanning multiple teams and products involving multiple AI approaches. You will closely work with Senior Applied Scientists owning explainability, causal reasoning, intelligent retrieval and question answering over knowledge graphs.

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist, you will:

• lead the semantic layer for agentic AI, including developing and assessing the ontological foundations that enable autonomous workflows and cross-site best practice sharing. You will also disseminate governance and standardization practices that ensure downstream consumers (including retrieval and explainability systems) operate on consistent, well-defined semantics
• design, build, and deploy graph-based AI solutions that combine knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and ML models to extract meaning from large-scale unstructured document collections, enabling data discovery, classification, and governance across RME
• define and own knowledge pipelines that extract, transform, and enrich entity relationships from diverse unstructured and semi-structured sources into production-grade knowledge graphs, ensuring reliability and accuracy of the overall information architecture
• collaborate with fellow senior scientists to design, deploy, and operate graph and vector databases to support retrieval, causal reasoning, and analytics use case as well as ensure contributing scientists maintain versioning, validation state, and provenance for every knowledge graph entry
• collaborate with fellow senior applied scientists to ensure ontology and schema design decisions optimize for queryability, so that question-answering and retrieval systems can leverage the semantic layer with minimal impedance mismatch
• integrate LLMs and ML models into text processing pipelines for classification, embedding generation, document similarity, entity extraction, and semantic analysis, applying rigorous experimentation and evaluation methodology to select the best fit-for purpose approach
• design ontological structures that support explainability, enabling agents and reasoning systems to trace reasoning paths and surface provenance, enabling governance-level transparency for autonomous AI actions
• optimize models and inference pipelines for production constraints including latency, throughput, cost, and infrastructure reliability
• establish best practices and standards for knowledge engineering and applied science processes, elevating the maturity of RME's data, information, and AI capabilities
• mentor and train colleagues on knowledge graph concepts, semantic modelling, and applied AI techniques

About the team

The Amazon Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) team maintains and optimizes technologies ranging from large, modern, purpose-built warehouses utilizing robotics and high-volume conveyance all the way through the value chain to small, high-speed warehouses placed as close to our customers as possible. Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) uses science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally. We do this to meet our customer promise, reduce costs, and support the Climate Pledge.

asic Qualifications

- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
- Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- • MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Information Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent industry experience)
- • Proven experience developing and deploying production knowledge graphs in real business scenarios at enterprise scale
- • Deep expertise in semantic technologies, modelling languages (RDF, OWL, etc..), and querying languages (SPARQL, Gremlin, Cypher, or other GQLs);
- • Experience with MLOps practices: building production-grade pipelines, CI/CD for ML, containerization, and monitoring of deployed AI solutions
- • Appetite for staying at the forefront of semantic web technologies and graph applications

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
- • PhD in a relevant field with publications in knowledge representation, NLP, or graph-based AI
- • Familiarity with graph visualization tools and techniques
- • Experience leveraging graph theory (traversals, centrality, community detection) and graph analytics in applied settings
- • Experience designing clean, modular, and testable ML code in a collaborative environment

title: Associate Corporate Counsel, Health & Safety (m/f)
description:
Associate Corporate Counsel, Health & Safety
Job ID: 10512588 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

Join Amazon's Operations Legal Department to provide strategic legal counsel on workplace health and safety matters across our European operations. You'll advise business leaders on compliance with European safety regulations and navigate regulatory interactions. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-moving, multi-jurisdictional regulatory environment and make a tangible impact on employee safety.

Our lawyers value working alongside and in person with their business clients and local legal teams to solve a constant flow of novel challenges in a growing and exciting business. This position can be based in either our offices in Luxembourg or Madrid. Some regional and international travel will be required.

Key job responsibilities

- Provide day-to-day legal counsel to operations and safety teams on workplace safety regulatory compliance
- Drive the legal response to workplace incidents and escalations, partnering with senior and country-specific counsel as needed
- Assist in managing regulatory interactions, including inspections, investigations, and information requests from national authorities
- Monitor changes in workplace health and safety regulations across jurisdictions and advise on necessary business adaptations
- Support the development and improvement of health and safety compliance policies, procedures, and training materials
- Work cross-functionally with technology teams to implement automated compliance solutions
- Help build and maintain productive relationships with regulatory agencies across Europe

A day in the life

You'll provide real-time advice to operations and safety partners on practical compliance questions, from interpreting local regulations to coordinating the legal responses to regulatory interactions. Expect a mix of independent research, collaborative policy work, and real-time counseling. The work is fast-paced, intellectually challenging, and directly connected to employee safety.

About the team

We are part of Amazon's Worldwide Operations Legal group, supporting regulatory and safety compliance across Europe. Our team works closely with stakeholders to develop industry-leading compliance and safety solutions. Safety is a top priority for Amazon's leadership, giving our work significant visibility at senior levels.

Basic Qualifications

- License to practice law in Europe, US or other common law jurisdiction
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- A minimum of 2+ years post-qualification legal experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in Workplace Safety Law
- Experience in Regulatory Law
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience managing multiple projects and meeting aggressive deadlines

title: Quality Control Chemistry Analyst (Ref no: 449301)
description:
Job description  
To perform testing of finished goods according to specified procedures and in compliance to EU GMP
- To prepare, standardise and label stock solutions and laboratory reagents as required.
- To routinely monitor and analyse the water supply according to Company procedures.
- To ensure that all equipment, apparatus and premises of the QC Department are functional and suitable
for their intended use, by performing maintenance and calibration as instructed.  Apparatus should be
handled in the proper manner and not in a way which may be detrimental to its function.
- To assist outside contractors in performing calibrations throughout the company and keep records of
these according to standard procedures as required.
- To report LIRs and deviations in a timely manner.
- To work out calculations pertaining to analysis and produce the relevant documentation in association
always in compliance to EU GMP.  To ensure proper filing and easy retrieval of all documentation and
records pertaining to the QC Department.
- To assist the immediate superiors in problem solving exercises and other exercises aimed at improving
quality and efficiency.
- To perform laboratory equipment qualification and calibration accordingly to a predetermined schedule.
- To perform method validation as required.
- To maintain records of stocks of reagents, equipment spares and reference standards in such a way as
to report when re-ordering is due.
- To support the Technical Services personnel on laboratory investigations resulting from OOS, OOT and
OOE results and any deviations arising from the QC laboratory.
- To investigate and perform the prescribed hypothesis testing and analysis in conjunction with any quality
and root cause analysis investigations.  
- To follow and document (record) precisely all activities as described in the relevant Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs), Test Methods and Protocols.  
- To perform all duties as laid down and any additional duties as may be allocated from time to time by the
QC Manager or delegate in a proper professional manner and in the best interest of APL Swift Services
(Malta) Ltd.

title: Aquaculture Technician  (Ref no: 454210)
description:
Working with a team of biologists and engineers, this challenging and demanding position requires the
selected candidate to work in the company's aquatic research facility based in Malta, the largest
private facility of its kind in Europe. The activities carried out at the facility include work on various
aquatic nutrition trials and health related experiments undertaken on a range of freshwater and marine
species of fish, shrimp and live feed; the technician would be involved in all aspects of the daily
operations as well as being involved in specific research assignments.

NOTE: All applicants must have an EU/EEA/UK passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with the required permits and have an excellent command of the English
language, written and spoken.  

Job description  
A position within the AquaBioTech Group has arisen for a suitably qualified person to work as an
aquaculture / aquatic technician on a variety of research projects at our R&D facility known as ABT
Innovia. The responsibilities of the selected candidate are defined as follows:

Key Accountabilities
. The work is focused on the wet-labs facility of AquaBioTech Group (ABT Innovia), with
primary duties on maintaining livestock and RAS systems. These tasks involve mostly feeding
and health monitoring of the livestock, RAS system maintenance, inspection and
housekeeping, monitoring water quality and experimental trials activities and reporting.
. Day to day coordination and execution of all national and international research projects that
the AquaBioTech Group and its partners are awarded, ensuring that all the research
contracts are managed and executed within the timeframes and budgets provided and all
deliverables are met. This includes ensuring that all SOP and required accreditations, such as
GLP and GMP, are achieved and maintained.
. Be involved in various aspects of the design, engineering and logistics of bringing a RAS
project through to installation and beyond.

Reporting directly to the R&D Facilities Manager, the position is demanding requiring a person who is
highly motivated, methodical and organised. The selected person must be prepared to work to very
tight deadlines in isolated and multi-functional projects and in conjunction with a team of international
staff. AquaBioTech Group has also been awarded, and is continuously seeking to win more, research
projects funded by local government and the EU.

Requirements
. The successful candidate is likely to have a good solid background in aquaculture sciences,
preferably with at least a B.Sc. level of education, although experienced technician candidates are
also encouraged to apply. Experience in laboratory operating procedures and GMP and GLP is
also a bonus, but not essential as all training in these procedures will be provided.
. The selected candidate will be required to speak and write English fluently, and knowledge of any
other languages would be considered an asset, although not essential.
. The selected candidate must have a clean EU / EEA passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with no travel restrictions or legal convictions and be in possession of
a clean driving licence.

Training provided
Successful candidates will go through our internal onboarding procedure, whereas all information and
documentation will be provided before start date, for information and signing.

Any assistance with accommodation/relocation
AquaBioTech Group offers all employees company accommodation, which comes at cheaper rates
compared to personal renting, and which will be available immediately for new employees to use upon
their arrival. All preparation related to accommodation is handled by the company.

Salary
Euro 17,500 to Euro 19,000 per year.

The successful candidate will be offered a long-term, fixed-term contract with the company. The
starting package offered for this position will be structured largely upon the chosen candidate,
reflecting the experience the candidate brings to the company, but also in line with the cost of living in
Malta and could include an accommodation package, if required.

How will the interviews be held  
Both online and in-person interviews will be held, depending on the location of the individual.  

To apply
CVs and a covering email are to be sent by email to eures.recruitment.jobsplus@gov.mt and should
be written in English. Please quote the vacancy name and number (Ref no: 454210) in your email.

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.

    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.

    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.

Additional Responsibilities

Who and what we are after?

    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.

Employee benefits

Apply today and be part of our success story!

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

title: werkvoorbereider / werkcoördinator
description:
• Je plant en organiseert onderhoudswerken en projecten en zorgt ervoor dat alles vlot verloopt, van voorbereiding tot opvolging achteraf.
  • Je doet de nodige opmetingen en zoekt uit welke onderdelen en materialen nodig zijn, zodat alles tijdig besteld kan worden.
  • Je beheert het magazijn en houdt de voorraad van reserveonderdelen nauwkeurig bij.
  • Je volgt bestellingen op van bestelling tot levering en helpt mee bij het ontvangen en verwerken van goederen.
  • Je gaat op zoek naar geschikte leveranciers en alternatieve onderdelen om kwaliteit, beschikbaarheid en prijs te optimaliseren.
  • Je regelt de revisie van onderdelen en organiseert het transport naar externe partners wanneer nodig.
  • Je ondersteunt collega's tijdens onderhouds- en herstellingswerken en springt zelf bij waar nodig.
  • Je werkt mee aan de implementatie van SAP Plant Maintenance en helpt zo mee aan een efficiënte digitale opvolging van het onderhoud.
  • Je beschikt over een attest voor het besturen van een vorklift en elektrisch transpallet, of bent bereid dit via een opfrissing opnieuw te behalen.
  • Je kan vlot overweg met de courante Microsoft Office-toepassingen zoals Excel, Word en Outlook.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Je behoudt het overzicht, ook tijdens drukke periodes, en steekt graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen.
  • Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen en neemt initiatief om processen efficiënter te laten verlopen.
  • Je beschikt over een zeer grondige kennis Elektromechanica.

title: storingstechnieker Weekendploeg nacht
description:
Als technieker speel je een cruciale rol in het garanderen van een vlot en efficiënt productieproces. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het preventief onderhoud van ons geavanceerde machinepark, bestaande uit onder andere industriële molens, persen en diverse productielijnen. Daarnaast zorg je ervoor dat ook de ondersteunende installaties, zoals verwarmingssystemen, stoominstallaties en koelinstallaties, optimaal blijven functioneren.

Wanneer zich technische storingen of defecten voordoen, ga je snel en doelgericht te werk om de oorzaak te achterhalen en een duurzame oplossing te bieden. Dankzij jouw technische expertise beperk je stilstanden tot een minimum en draag je rechtstreeks bij aan de continuïteit van onze productieactiviteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met een team van ervaren techniekers, waarbij kennisdeling en collegialiteit centraal staan. Samen streven jullie naar een veilige, betrouwbare en performante productieomgeving. In deze functie rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Maintenance Manager, die jou ondersteunt in je verdere ontwikkeling en groei binnen de organisatie.

title: AV programmer - Amersfoort
description:
Our client is the market leader in the audiovisual industry.

Responsibilities/Tasks  

The AV Programmer will be responsible for assisting customers with the installation and operation of a wide range of A/V control products.

Technical Support & Control Applications
.Provide remote and potentially on-site support for AV control systems, assisting with configuration, and troubleshooting.
.Diagnose issues related to control software, AV hardware communication (RS232, TCP/IP), and third-party device integration.
.Guide customers through system setup and resolve anomalies in software or hardware operation.
.Provide advanced training for customers-programmers, online or in internal or external facilities, on control solutions.

Sales & Feedback
.Provide feedback to the Control Manager when a case needs escalation.
.Inform product improvement needs to the Product & Development team based on field experience and tender requirements.
.Maintain awareness of certifications and specifications relevant to AV control systems.
.Report technical issues using internal tools.


Requirements    

A strong background in other control systems - such as AMX, Crestron, or QSC - is essential, along with solid experience in Python programming (or similar). The ideal candidate will demonstrate a deep understanding of integrated A/V environments and be capable of adapting to diverse technical challenges. We are looking for someone based in the BENELUX or DACH area that speaks fluent English.

Technical Expertise
.Strong knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS (servers, registry, DLLs), SQL databases.
.Solid understanding of networking (TCP/IP, Ethernet, IP addressing, NAT, routers).
.Proficiency in Python 3 programming and Visual Studio Code knowledge.
.Familiarity with communication protocols (RS232/RS422, SSH, web sockets).
.Experience with AV system integration and control platforms (Extron, AMX, Crestron).

Communication & Reporting
.Fluent in English, with good verbal and written communication skills.
.Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
.Methodical troubleshooting skills and attention to detail.
.Regular reporting on status using internal tools.

Education & Experience
.Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
.Proven experience in AV technical support, system design, and field commissioning of AV control systems.

Er moet niets, het gaat vooral om samen zijn. We doen spelletjes, kaarten, sjoelen. Drinken een kopje koffie en een drankje. Soms is er een bingo of komt er een koor optreden. Er komen gemiddeld 25 cliënten, de meeste wonen ook op locatie de Paardenmarkt. Sommigen komen met de bus van externe locaties. Het zijn oudere cliënten die functioneren op een laag tot hoog ontwikkelingsniveau. Kijk voor meer informatie over de locatie: Werken bij Ipse de Bruggen in Delft en Den Haag: een impressie Jouw baan als Vrijwilliger Ouderensoos Op vrijdagmiddag help je van 13.00 tot 16.30 uur bij de voorkomende werkzaamheden. Dat zijn spelletjes doen, koffiezetten, helpen bij het sjoelen en een gezellig praatje maken. Bij de soos werken meer vrijwilligers. Het is een gezellig groepje! Sommigen helpen ons al jaren, sommigen nog niet zo lang. Jouw profiel Je houdt van gezelligheid. En je vindt het leuk om samen met andere vrijwilligers en begeleiders onze bezoekers een leuke middag te bezorgen. Wat krijg je van ons Het aantal uren is in overleg; uiteraard houden wij rekening met je agenda en mogelijkheden. Wij zorgen goed voor onze vrijwilligers: Je wordt enthousiast ingewerkt. Je kunt je reiskosten declareren (in overleg onkosten). Er is jaarlijks een cursusaanbod over uiteen lopende thema’s. Wij zetten onze vrijwilligers regelmatig in het zonnetje. En hele dankbare gezichten omdat door jouw hulp meer mogelijk is. Informatie Je werkt bij Ipse de Bruggen vaak met kwetsbare cliënten en daarom zijn wij zeer zorgvuldig in ons selectiebeleid. De aanvraag Verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG), het navrage

van referenties en het opvragen van informatie bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd maken om die reden onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure. Voor informatie kun je contact opnemen met Leonie Vugts (begeleider DAC Paardenmarkt), tel: 088 - 967 74 60.

description:
Mit der Rossmann-Apotheke B.V. bauen wir ein neues Angebot im digitalen Gesundheitsmarkt auf: Eine vollwertige Apotheke, die einen einfachen, verantwortungsvollen und kundenorientierten Zugang zu Arzneimitteln und apothekennaher Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen wird. Dabei verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines krisenfesten Unternehmens mit der Dynamik eines modernen E-Commerce- und Logistikumfelds.

In der Rolle unterstützen Sie den Aufbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke von Anfang an mit. Statt bestehende Strukturen zu verwalten, entwickeln Sie als Dienstleister für die Apotheke neue Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Sortimentsstrategien und Wachstumsfelder für ein Geschäftsfeld mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung.

Das bewirken Sie bei uns

Als Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie übernehmen Sie die strategische Verantwortung für ausgewählte Sortimentsbereiche der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Sie entwickeln Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Preis- und Sortimentsstrategien und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum eines zukunftsorientierten Geschäftsfeldes. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Sortimentsstrategie:  Sie bauen unsere pharmazeutischen Sortimente im eCommerce kontinuierlich auf und identifizieren neue Umsatz-, Markt- und Wachstumspotenziale zur Etablierung auf dem Markt
- Lieferantenentwicklung:  Sie bauen strategische Partnerschaften auf, entwickeln erste Kooperationen weiter und gestalten die zukünftige Lieferantenstruktur aktiv mit
- Verhandlungen:  Sie führen Jahresgespräche sowie Preis-, Konditions- und Vertragsverhandlungen und erzielen nachhaltige Ergebnisse für unser Geschäft
- Preisstrategie:  Sie analysieren Markt-, Sortiments- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leiten daraus fundierte Preis- und Handlungsempfehlungen ab
- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit schaffen Sie es sich ein Netzwerk in der Pharmabranche aufzubauen
- Innovation:  Sie treiben Zukunftsthemen wie den Ausbau von Direktbezugsmodellen und die Entwicklung neuer Lieferantenstrategien im Apothekenumfeld voran

Das bringen Sie mit

Als Service Coördinator ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen onze klanten, de werkplaats en het magazijn. Jij houdt het overzicht, regelt de planning en zorgt dat alles klopt - vanaf het eerste contact met de klant tot en met de factuur. Geen dag is hetzelfde, en dat is precies wat jouw werk leuk maakt. Zo minimaliseer je de stilstand van de truck en vergroot je de klanttevredenheid.
Met behulp van onze dealersystemen werk je procesmatig en resultaatgericht. Gesucht wird eine*n Sales Engineer (m/w/d) im Bereich Ventiltechnik für die Märkte Niederlande und Belgien. Unser Kunde entwickelt und vertreibt magnetgesteuerte Ventile, druckgesteuerte Systeme sowie individuelle Lösungen für industrielle Anwendungen. Die Position bietet viel Gestaltungsspielraum, internationale Kundenkontakte und wird durch uns im Rahmen einer Direktanstellung beim Kunden besetzt.

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Sie betreuen Bestandskunden in den Niederlanden und Belgien technisch und vertrieblich.

- Sie analysieren technische Anforderungen und entwickeln passende Lösungskonzepte.
- Sie koordinieren Projekte gemeinsam mit internen Fachabteilungen und begleiten Angebote bis zum Abschluss.
- Sie beobachten Markt- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und identifizieren neue Vertriebspotenziale.

- Sie verfügen über eine technische oder technisch-kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Fluidtechnik, Maschinenbau oder Automatisierungstechnik.

- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten beim Kunden.

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum im internationalen Vertrieb.
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Prozesse und Märkte.
- Spannende Kundenprojekte im industriellen Umfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive.
- Ein wertschätzendes, mittelständisch geprägtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Was wir bieten:

- Persönliche Beratung und individuelle Begleitung während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses.
- Zugang zu exklusiven Positionen im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau mit internationalem Umfeld.

- Vertrauliche und professionelle Betreuung mit transparenter Kommunikation.

title: Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie - ROSSMANN-Apotheke B.V. (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
Mit der Rossmann-Apotheke B.V. bauen wir ein neues Angebot im digitalen Gesundheitsmarkt auf: Eine vollwertige Apotheke, die einen einfachen, verantwortungsvollen und kundenorientierten Zugang zu Arzneimitteln und apothekennaher Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen wird. Dabei verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines krisenfesten Unternehmens mit der Dynamik eines modernen E-Commerce- und Logistikumfelds.

In der Rolle unterstützen Sie den Aufbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke von Anfang an mit. Statt bestehende Strukturen zu verwalten, entwickeln Sie als Dienstleister für die Apotheke neue Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Sortimentsstrategien und Wachstumsfelder für ein Geschäftsfeld mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung.

Das bewirken Sie bei uns

Als Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie übernehmen Sie die strategische Verantwortung für ausgewählte Sortimentsbereiche der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Sie entwickeln Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Preis- und Sortimentsstrategien und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum eines zukunftsorientierten Geschäftsfeldes. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Sortimentsstrategie:  Sie bauen unsere pharmazeutischen Sortimente im eCommerce kontinuierlich auf und identifizieren neue Umsatz-, Markt- und Wachstumspotenziale zur Etablierung auf dem Markt
- Lieferantenentwicklung:  Sie bauen strategische Partnerschaften auf, entwickeln erste Kooperationen weiter und gestalten die zukünftige Lieferantenstruktur aktiv mit
- Verhandlungen:  Sie führen Jahresgespräche sowie Preis-, Konditions- und Vertragsverhandlungen und erzielen nachhaltige Ergebnisse für unser Geschäft
- Preisstrategie:  Sie analysieren Markt-, Sortiments- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leiten daraus fundierte Preis- und Handlungsempfehlungen ab
- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit schaffen Sie es sich ein Netzwerk in der Pharmabranche aufzubauen
- Innovation:  Sie treiben Zukunftsthemen wie den Ausbau von Direktbezugsmodellen und die Entwicklung neuer Lieferantenstrategien im Apothekenumfeld voran

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation:  Ihre Basis ist ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Pharmazie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung:  Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf, Category Management oder im Lieferantenmanagement mit und haben bereits Verantwortung für Sortimente, Umsatz- oder Geschäftsentwicklung übernommen
- Branchenverständnis:   Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrungen im Pharma-, Healthcare-, Apotheken-, Handels- oder FMCG-Umfeld
- Verhandlungsgeschick:  Sie überzeugen durch eine hohe Abschlussstärke und haben Erfahrung in der Führung anspruchsvoller Lieferanten- und Vertragsverhandlungen
- Analysekompetenz:   Auf Basis von Kennzahlen, Marktanalysen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen treffen Sie Entscheidungen
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Innovationsgeist:   Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, Chancen in dynamischen Märkten zu identifizieren, innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese erfolgreich in nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge zu überführen
- Reisebereitschaft:  Den persönlichen Austausch mit Geschäftspartnern schätzen Sie und bringen die Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen mit

- 37,5-Stunden-Woche
- 30 Tage Urlaub

- Umfassendes Onboarding
- Personalrabatt & Einkaufsgutscheine
- Kostenlose Parkplätze

title: Agile Coach Definition
description:
Agile coach
As organizations transition to Agile methodologies, they may need the expertise of an Agile Coach. An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. In this text, we will discuss the definition, competencies and responsibilities of an Agile Coach.
Definition Agile Coach
An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile -methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. The goal of an Agile Coach is to advise organizations on how to improve their practices and integrate Agile methodologies. Agile Coaches are experts in understanding and adhering to Agile principles and ensuring that teams and individuals use the right tools and techniques to achieve desired results.
Key competencies
An Agile Coach needs a number of key competencies to be effective in his or her role. Some of these competencies are:
Knowledge of Agile methodologies : Is familiar with Agile methodologies and the principles behind them. He or she should be able to clearly explain and guide the application of these principles in practice.
Coaching and Training: Must be able to coach and train effectively. This includes the ability to ask the right questions, provide feedback and ensure good communication.
Leadership: Must be a Servant Leader. Servant-Leadership is a "way of being and doing" in which the leader is subservient to the growth of others, the organization and himself. In doing so, this philosophy contributes to a development of society as a whole.
Problem Solving: Must be able to solve problems and identify bottlenecks in the Agile process. He or she should be able to identify appropriate solutions and advise on their implementation.

title: Frati Restaurant is looking for dishwasher
description:
We are looking for dishwasher for a 90% position (approximately 160 hours per month) with the possibility of permanent employment.

The work schedule is fixed and consists of two shift types:

  • 16:00 -- 22:00

  • 21:30 -- 3:30

Due to late night shifts, employees are responsible for arranging their own transportation home after work, especially if they live outside areas served by late-night public transportation.

We are looking for reliable and hardworking individuals who understand the importance of cleanliness and hygiene in a professional kitchen environment and who contribute positively to the workplace.

About Frati

Frati is an exciting restaurant to work for. We brew our own beer, produce our own fresh pasta, maintain an herb garden, and are proud to offer one of Trondheim's best wine lists.

As a dishwasher at Frati, you will play an important role in keeping our kitchen operations running smoothly. We are especially interested in candidates who take pride in their work, have a positive attitude, and perform well in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fixed schedule with both evening and night shifts

  • Modern dishwashing area equipped with a conveyor dishwasher

  • Washing kitchen production equipment

  • Washing plates, glasses, and cutlery from the restaurant

  • Cleaning and maintaining the dishwashing area

  • General cleaning duties

  • Waste management

  • Good physical condition and ability to stand and work for extended periods

  • Courses or certifications related to cleaning, chemical handling, food safety, or similar are considered an advantage

Personal Qualities

  • Positive and friendly attitude

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong work ethic

  • Reliable and punctual

  • Flexible regarding evening and night shifts

Start date: ASAP

Feel free to visit our website or our Facebook and Instagram pages to learn more about our restaurant.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Frati er smaken av Italia - midt i Trondheim. I snart 50 år har den italienske restauranten servert velsmakende retter, og er kjent for sine fristende appetittvekkere, bedre middager og et bredt utvalg av gode viner.

I den familiedrevede restauranten krydres gode råvarer med livsglede og trivelige mennesker. Gjestfriheten er stor, og alt er lagt til rette for du kan senke skuldrene og nyte en kveld med god mat og godt selskap i en ekte italiensk restaurant.

Frati er en del av Fratigruppen og har drevet restauranter i Trondheim siden 1973. For oss er det to ting som er viktig. At våre ansatte har det bra på jobb og at gjestene har det bra i restauranten. title: Ringevikarer i Tomteråsen barnehage
description:
Vi søker nå etter ringevikarer som kan vikariere i vår barnehage over kortere eller lengre perioder, ved sykdom og fravær i barnehagen. Det er estimert at behovet er mellom 20-50 %.

Det er viktig at du er:

  • Engasjert i barnets utvikling og barnehagehverdagen.

  • Glad i å være ute

  • Tar barneperspektivet

  • Glad i å leke. Utetiden ute handler ikke om å sitte på benkene

  • Fleksibel.

  • Ansvarsfull

  • Har et genuint ønske om å være tilstede for barna i hverdagen, samt være med å bidra i vårt team med flinke og pliktoppfyllende ansatte.

Det er en stor fordel at du har førerkort klasse B, da barnehagen ligger slik til at den har begrenset med bussforbindelser.

Det er en fordel at du har erfaring med barn, men opplæring vil bli gitt. Det viktigste er at ønsket om å lære er tilstede, og at du er en pålitelig arbeidstaker.

Du må snakke godt norsk da en del av barnehagens hverdag består av å lære de å snakke.

Politiattest må fremlegges før ansettelse.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Tomteråsen barnehage Sa er en liten foreldreeid barnehage beliggende inne på boligfeltet på Tomteråsen i Nes kommune. Vi driftes som en ideel barnehage og vi er medlem av PBL.

Det er totalt 3 avdelinger i barnehagen, og vi har stort fokus på landbruk og miljø.

Med Hvam VGS rett ved siden av oss har vi et godt samarbeid her, og er ofte på besøk for stell av dyr og hjelp til å høste blant annet grønnsaker og poteter. Vi baker vårt eget brød hver dag og har varmmat flere ganger i uken.

Vi har egen lavvo i skogen på Tomteråsen, og bålplass på uteområdet vårt. Forholdene ligger godt til rette for gode turopplevelser i alle aldre.

Våre åpningstider er 06.45-17.15 og vi er åpent hele året. I romjulen og dagene før påsken har vi begrenset åpningstid.

Vi har fokus på små grupper og deler oss ofte for å kunne se alle barna slik at de har en god hverdag både fysisk og psykisk.

Se mer om barnehagen vår på vår hjemmeside: www.tomterasen.barnehage.no eller følg oss på instagram: Tomteråsenbarnehage

title: Jobb sammen med dyktige og erfarne kolleger og bidra til en god barndom
description:
Vil du ha en variert og meningsfull arbeidsdag, være sammen med flotte nysgjerrige og aktive barn. Legge til rette for en trygg og god barndom. Tilbringe mye tid ute og oppleve natur og husdyr sammen med barna. Da er du den vi ser etter.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har et ekte engasjement for at hverdagen i barnehagen blir rik på læring, opplevelser og trygghet.

Erfaring fra barnehagen er en fordel men det viktigste er hvem du er og hvordan du møter barna

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Bidra til en trygg, omsorgsfull og inkluderende hverdag for barna.

  • Delta aktivt i lek, aktiviteter og hverdagsrutiner

  • Være en trygg og tilstedeværende voksen i møte med barn

  • Legge til rette for barns lek, læring, mestring og utvikling

  • Samarbeide i team og bidra til et positivt arbeidsmiljø

  • Ha forståelse for relasjonsbygging, profesjonell omsorg og inkludering


Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr:

Et lærende miljø, en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag

Fleksibilitet som tilkallingsvikar og mulighet for arbeid ved behov

En jobb hvor ingen dager er like, men hver dag by på nye opplevelser og ekte glede

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Holmen gårds- og naturbarnehage AS er en privat barnehage på Raipas ca. 7 kilometer fra Alta sentrum. Barnehagen startet opp i midlertidige lokaler på Masternes gård høsten 2010.

Barnehagens nybygg ble ferdigstilt før nyttår 2010.

Barnehagen har en barnegruppe med ca. 27 barn i alderen 1 -- 6 år.

title: Miljøarbeider 100% stilling.
description:
Miljøarbeider 100% i prosjektstilling.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi søker først og fremst etter den rette personen. Erfaring fra omsorgsarbeid, miljøarbeid, helse, barn og ungdom eller lignende er en fordel, men personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Du bør være trygg og tydelig, samtidig som du har evne til å bygge gode relasjoner. Du må kunne arbeide selvstendig, ta initiativ og håndtere at arbeidsdagene kan være forskjellige.

Det er en fordel om du er praktisk anlagt og liker en aktiv arbeidshverdag.

Førerkort klasse B er nødvendig. Politiattest må fremlegges før tiltredelse.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Dette er en allsidig og variert stilling. Arbeidsdagen kan bestå av miljøarbeid og oppfølging av brukere, samtidig som du deltar i aktiviteter både på og utenfor gården.

Arbeidsoppgavene kan blant annet være:

  • oppfølging og miljøarbeid med barn, ungdom og voksne

  • praktisk bistand og ADL-trening

  • aktiviteter, turer og fysisk aktivitet

  • arbeid og aktiviteter knyttet til gården og dyrene

  • matlaging og andre daglige gjøremål

  • dokumentasjon og rapportering

  • samarbeid med kollegaer og andre samarbeidspartnere

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr en spennende 100 % prosjektstilling med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og stor mulighet til å påvirke egen arbeidshverdag. Du blir en del av et tverrfaglig arbeidsmiljø med fokus på trygghet, aktivitet, mestring og gode opplevelser for brukerne. Lønn etter tariff.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vi holder til på Mellem Gård i Brøstadbotn og tilbyr omsorgs-, avlastnings- og aktivitetstjenester for barn, ungdom og voksne. Hos oss kombineres miljøarbeid med praktiske aktiviteter, gårdsliv og tett oppfølging av den enkelte.

title: Ekstrahjelp søkes til tannklinikk i Bergen Sentrum
description:
Tannlege Forland søker ekstrahjelp hver onsdag og evt ferier frem til og med julen 2026, med mulighet til forlengelse av stilling.

Vi er to tannleger og to sekretærer per i dag, med en sekretær i permisjon.

Vi søker deg med stor interesse for tannhelsefaget med relevant erfaring, eller med stort ønske om å lære. Studerer du til å bli tannhelsesekretær er dette perfekt.

Klinikken er sentralt lokalisert i Bergen Sentrum, med stor pågang av pasienter. Vi er opptatt av godt arbeidsmiljø og ønsker at du som søker også er positiv, lærevillig, serviceinnstilt og samarbeider godt.

Søknader behandles fortløpende, og oppstart er ønsket så fort det lar seg gjøre.

Ser frem til å ønske rette vedkommende velkommen til oss!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Privat tannklinikk i Bergen Sentrum.

Klinikken er lokalisert i Olav Kyrresgate, med buss- og bybaneforbindelser rett utenfor kontoret.

Vi er 2 tannleger og 2 sekretærer, hvor den ene sekretæren er i mamma-permisjon nå.

Sjekk gjerne ut hjemmesiden vår for å lese mer om oss.

description:

description:

other proudction related work.

Ability to work independently, efficiently and purposefully while working well in a team

Norwegian or English language, both oral and written

Personal characteristics :-

Liming og kapping av keramikk og stein material.
